jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Cloud Infrastructure Engineer works day-to-day on all aspects of managing and maintaining the  cloud infrastructure environments that support the software platform we provide to our customers, as  well as our internal systems. This is a hands-on, deeply technical role operating within a regulated  financial services environment, where our infrastructure is directly accessed by customers and  connected to third-party trading, settlement and market data services. 

The successful candidate will combine strong core Azure and Windows infrastructure skills with genuine  depth in networking, firewalling, directory services and database administration. They will be  comfortable owning complex, business-critical migrations end-to-end, liaising directly with vendors and  customers, and producing high-quality documentation to support the wider team and our audit and  compliance obligations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Managing internal and customer server infrastructure on Microsoft Azure, including VMs, Network Security Groups, ExpressRoute, Application Gateways/WAF and other key Azure resources. 
• Designing, configuring and troubleshooting network connectivity between customers, third  parties and our platform, including site-to-site VPNs, routing, NAT/PAT and DNS.
• Administering internal and customer-facing firewalls, in particular Fortinet FortiGate
• Building and maintaining connectivity to external trading, settlement and market data services  (e.g. payment/settlement gateways such as CREST, and trading interfaces).
• Administering and maintaining Active Directory, including trusts, Kerberos delegation, certificate services and certificate lifecycle management.
• Maintaining and supporting Microsoft SQL Server, including patching, monitoring and day-to-day administration, and maintaining our high availability and disaster recovery configurations.
• Testing and maintaining backups and DR processes (including invocation testing) to ensure they meet contracted RPO/RTO obligations.
• Managing and maintaining the Microsoft 365 environment and associated tools.
• Maintaining external-facing infrastructure (e.g. web servers, reverse proxies, DNS and public certificates).
• Routine patching and maintenance of servers and firewalls.
• Maintenance of our software and associated components on Third Platform Services (TPS).
• Responding to IT audit and customer due-diligence information requests and providing  supporting evidence. 
• Work alongside group information security to ensure infrastructure is designed, configured and  maintained in line with security policies, control frameworks and audit requirements, and to  support remediation of identified risks and vulnerabilities. 
• Managing relationships with third-party vendors and suppliers (e.g. Microsoft, Fortinet,  connectivity and settlement providers), including technical liaison, escalations and coordinating  delivery of changes.
• Producing and maintaining clear technical documentation, runbooks and knowledgebase articles to support the team, ensure resilience of knowledge, and satisfy audit requirements.
• Monitoring and responding to alerts as they arise from the infrastructure and monitoring platforms.
• Out-of-hours work for routine maintenance and occasional project work.
• Working on other IT projects relating to infrastructure and security as required.
• Contributing to team planning.

KEY ATTRIBUTES AND SKILLS 
Essential

• Proven experience in a similar technical role involving infrastructure and cloud  technology.
• Experience in an environment providing and supporting B2B customer-facing technology.
• Experience working within a regulated or externally audited industry, with an understanding of contractual obligations and control frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2 / ISAE 3402 / AAF, and  CIS benchmarks/controls (or equivalents such as NIST).
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
• Self-motivated, and capable of tackling complex projects either on their own or as part of a team.
• Able to work collaboratively across different departments/teams with differing technical capabilities, and with external customers and vendors, to deliver effective solutions.
• Proven experience with Microsoft Azure and Windows Server administration.
• Strong networking and firewalling depth, in particular NAT/PAT, site-to-site (IPsec) VPN, routing and DNS.
• Advanced Active Directory administration, including trusts, Kerberos delegation and certificate management.
• Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD in depth – Enterprise applications, SSO, Conditional Access, hybrid identity.
• Microsoft SQL Server administration – backup/restore and recovery, security/permissions, SQL Agent job management.
• Knowledge of Windows-based IIS application administration.
• PowerShell scripting.
• Office 365 administration and automation.
• Experience with backup and DR tools and processes.
• Strong documentation skills and experience managing third-party vendors/suppliers.

Desirable 

• Microsoft Dynamics CRM administration.
• ADFS administration.
• SQL Server high availability and disaster recovery design: e.g. Always On availability groups, clustering, log shipping.
• Microsoft BizTalk Server and Microsoft SharePoint Server administrator.
• Fortinet/FortiGate firewall administration.                                                                                      
• Experience with PRTG, Grafana, or similar monitoring platforms.
• Atlassian suite – Jira ticketing and project management, Confluence documentation

Industry-specific experience:

• Payment/settlement gateways (e.g. CREST/Euroclear), trading  interfaces, CASS, and similar financial-market infrastructure.
• Wealth management / stockbroking domain knowledge.
• Understanding of modern infrastructure automation such as Terraform.

A little about us  
We’re the Nucleus Financial Platforms group and we help make retirement more rewarding.  

People come first - whether it’s our colleagues, or the advisers and customers we support, we know that working in partnership and collaboration leads to the best outcomes. Together, we’ve shaped the platform to how it is today. We work hard, and we celebrate hard too.  

Our ambition is to create a platform with a difference, putting the customer centre stage meant tearing up the rule book and starting from scratch. We’ve come a long way since then, but our mission remains just as focused. That’s why our culture, values, and social responsibility are things we keep at the top of our agenda – because we know they matter and have a big impact.  

Our culture is one of the many things that sets us apart from the pack. We want to have an environment where our people feel that they can make a real difference, know they’ll be rewarded for their efforts and more importantly, enjoy themselves at work.  

Inclusion and diversity at Nucleus  
As with most things in life, who cares, wins. We really care about inclusion.  
For us it’s not a tick box exercise; inclusion and diversity are embedded in our culture and everything we do. It’s a commercial imperative. It isn’t about being PC. It’s about being future-relevant and durable. We owe it to ourselves and the industry to ensure we are playing our part in creating a fair, balanced and transparent financial services sector.  

More diversity means broader experience, a wider set of perspectives and a better collective ability to problem-solve. And it means being more representative of customer groups, which supports areas such as product development.  

At Nucleus, we offer a generous blend of benefits for the things that really matter to our people, including a non-contributory pension, bonus, enhanced parental leave, paid time off for emergencies, health and wellbeing initiatives and flexible working options.

Application Operations Engineer - Tech CSC - Counter Terrorism Policing HQ

Location:
CSC, West Midlands

Job Summary

As an Application Operations Engineer, you'll support business-critical systems that are vital to our work in an ITIL-aligned environment. It's an IT role like no other, which comes with excellent training and the chance to build your skills. The Customer Service Centre (CSC) provide IT support to the Counter Terrorism Policing network. With the growing threat to National Security, we need to add to our dedicated teams. It's your chance to play your part in supporting UK policing.
This role is aligned to the Application Operations Engineer
role set out within the Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (DDAT).
Thanks to fast-evolving technology, new applications are being developed for policing all the time. Your task will be to help support this growing area by tackling applications-related issues. Day-to-Day, you'll assist the Senior Application Operations Engineers and Data Engineers in maintaining the Applications portfolio to ensure we have an accurate record of supported applications. You'll also be an escalation point for all applications-related incidents, managing them through to resolution. Whenever new or improved applications roll out, your role will be key in making sure that live support is seamless.
We want you to take the initiative when it comes to good working practices and processes. So you'll need experience of applications management and ideally, knowledge of ITIL-environments. With this expertise, you'll feel confident taking responsibility for outstanding faults, liaising with users and the other technical teams.
While an understanding of Microsoft development tools is essential (IIS, .NET, MS-SQL, Visual Studio), you should be just as adept with people – and be able to explain technical issues simply and form good working relationships. If you can combine customer service experience with strong IT literacy, we can offer you an exciting role in a supportive team. The applications in our portfolio are mostly bespoke, but we'll make sure you get first-class training and an excellent work/life balance.
Join us, and you’ll be part of a team of engineers covering core working hours weekdays from the CSC operations centre and on call (roughly 1 week in 8). The role is office-based with occasional opportunities to work from home.
Key Tasks

The post holder will be required to do the following:
Working within a service team monitoring components such as web servers, applications servers, log files, disk space and MS-SQL databases.
A point of escalation for all Application related issues within the Applications Team
Working as part of a second line support function following incident management through to incident resolution. Natural problem solving with ability to apply previous experience to new problems working towards route cause analysis.
Working with third party suppliers, stakeholders and departmental ICT teams to assist in delivering patch/release of applications while coordinating vendor support.
Maintaining middleware such as; IIS, MS-SQL Server, Active Directory, ASP and. NET, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, basic querying and resolving bottlenecks.
Daily support of COTS and WEB based software applications with an emphasis on the ability to problem solve.
Strong customer focus – understanding the needs of the internal and external customer and keeping them in mind when taking actions or making decisions.

Vetting

This post requires access to the most sensitive intelligence material on a daily basis. Applicants must hold or be prepared to undergo National Security Vetting (NSV) Developed Vetting (DV) level before taking up the post.
Please note the successful candidate will be part of a recruitment pipeline for a period of up to 12 months.
Confidentiality Agreement

Applicants should also be aware of the need to sign a confidentiality agreement on taking up the post.
Our Colleague Commitments

Counter Terrorism Policing (CTP) continues to prioritize an inclusive and supportive working environment and culture, where all of our people feel a strong sense of belonging and are empowered to reach their full potential. CTP keeps the nation and everyone in it safe from all manner of threats and as those threats evolve, so do we - that’s why Inclusion, Diversity and Equality (IDE) is the key to supporting our greatest asset, our people.
Our people protect our national security across the UK. In order to continue to deliver against our organizational priorities, we collectively seek to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, supported and valued to fully participate in the delivery of our mission – “working to keep people safe from Terrorism”.
IDE is at the heart of our approach to make the composition of Counter Terrorism Policing more representative of the communities we serve. As Counter Terrorism is rooted in Local Policing, to tackle today’s complex policing challenges, applications from across all backgrounds, cultures and experiences are therefore essential and encouraged. The CTP Network is committed to ensuring that candidates identifying as disabled are able to realize their fullest career aspirations and, as such, will endeavor to accommodate any reasonable adjustments that you may require during the recruitment process. CTP also welcomes applications from candidates seeking flexible working arrangements, . All flexible working arrangements should be discussed and agreed with the hiring manager.
This role does not attract Shift Disturbance Allowance. If you are currently in a shift-working role, SDA should cease upon appointment to this job.

Following application review, successful candidates will be invited to interview.

A leading organisation within the financial services sector
is undergoing a major technology transformation, modernising its core trading, data, and analytics platforms. With significant investment into its technology function, the business is building a next-generation platform to support data-driven decision making and improve the way its trading teams operate.

As part of this transformation, the organisation is seeking a Head of Engineering
to lead a growing technology function across software development, data engineering and QA
. This is a senior engineering leadership position with responsibility for technical direction, engineering standards, delivery and team development.

The Opportunity

This is a key leadership role for an experienced engineering leader who enjoys working in a hands-on, technically complex environment. You will lead the engineering function while remaining close to the technology, working with developers, data engineers and QA engineers to deliver high-quality platforms supporting the firm's financial services and trading activities.
You will take ownership of engineering strategy and delivery, helping shape the architecture, development practices and technology roadmap. You will work closely with senior stakeholders across technology and the business to ensure the engineering function continues to support the firm's trading and commercial objectives.

The platform will process and integrate large volumes of data, supporting teams across trading, risk, analytics and operations
. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering function and play a key role in the ongoing transformation of the firm's technology estate.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead and develop the engineering function across Software Development, Data Engineering and QA
.
• Own the engineering strategy, technical direction and delivery of critical technology across the firm's financial services and trading platforms.
• Build and maintain a high-performing engineering team, supporting recruitment, development, mentoring and progression.

You will be one of two DevOps Engineers who together own the path to production: the Azure environments, the CI/CD pipelines, the releases and the security and cost posture of the estate. Has 5+ years running production Azure environments as their primary discipline (App Services, Azure SQL, storage, networking fundamentals).
Has written and maintained CI/CD, build and deployment pipelines in Azure DevOps (YAML), including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables.
Routinely practices infrastructure as code (Bicep, ARM or Terraform) and is a confident scripter in PowerShell and the Azure CLI.
Strong appreciation for secure-by-default platform design: Key Vault, managed identities, RBAC and least privilege.
Has owned monitoring, backup and disaster recovery for a live service (Application Insights, Log Analytics), including responding to and resolving incidents.
Has worked in an Agile SCRUM team and is familiar with the associated ceremonies and artefacts.
Understands SQL Server well enough to manage environment data, refreshes and test data safely (in a Relational Database system).

Desirable

Microsoft certification: AZ-104 (Azure Administrator) or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Has run or supported one or more of the following Azure PaaS services: Azure Service Bus, Azure Functions, Azure API Management (APIM), Azure Logic Apps, Azure Data Factory / Synapse / Microsoft Fabric.
Enough C# / .NET to read application code and debug a failing build alongside the engineers.
Experience consolidating single-tenant, per-client deployments into a shared multi-tenant platform.
Experience of enterprise client security requirements (supplier security reviews, ISO 27001-style controls, penetration test remediation).
Practical use of AI-assisted tooling in platform and pipeline work.

Responsibilities

Environment management. Provision, configure and maintain the Astral environment estate (development, test, UAT/load and production), keeping environments consistent, reproducible and documented through infrastructure as code. CI/CD pipelines. Build, maintain and continuously improve our Azure DevOps build, test and release pipelines, including artifact management, controlled build configurations and pipeline variables, and automated quality and security gates. jobs.description:
Posting Type

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

Matter Administration helps customers grow and scale the eDiscovery practices and businesses they run on Relativity. The team delivers solutions that improve administrator productivity, simplify configuration, and streamline system preparation for matter review.

From matter setup and workspace configuration to data archiving, restore, cost management, and billing solutions, Matter Administration provides the tools and services Relativity Administrators use to manage their environments effectively.

This team is building a greenfield product and owns the full solution lifecycle, from implementation in .NET to deployment through GitHub Actions and monitoring with New Relic. Team members contribute to architecture, influence engineering best practices, and help shape modern, scalable cloud solutions.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, develop, test, deploy, and support RelativityOne cloud solutions built on Azure using .NET and C#. You will work as part of a Scrum team, collaborating closely with engineering peers and business stakeholders to deliver products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne platform.

You will contribute technical expertise across the software development lifecycle, mentor less experienced engineers, and support the team’s technical leadership while helping drive engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team throughout all phases of the software lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations.
Architect and design performant, scalable, and secure software solutions with a strong focus on quality.
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles using C#, TypeScript, and JavaScript, including SOLID principles and design patterns.
Provide technical guidance to help deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large volumes of data.
Participate in code reviews and promote engineering best practices.
Develop and execute comprehensive unit and integration testing strategies, including static analysis.
Improve software development processes by identifying and driving meaningful changes.
Identify, document, automate, and engineer solutions for repetitive operational tasks.
Contribute to and mature automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows.
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
Improve software quality, completeness, and knowledge sharing across the team.
Troubleshoot production issues, resolve defects, and respond to customer-specific problems.
Coach and mentor team members through technical guidance and education.
Participate in an on-call rotation as a second line of support after gaining sufficient domain experience.
Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, growth, and collaboration.

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience developing commercial software systems and applications using C#.
Experience building cloud-scalable solutions using cloud-native patterns, preferably on Microsoft Azure.
Experience working with scalable database technologies.
Experience building a cloud-focused DevOps mindset, including CI/CD processes and tools such as GitHub Actions, Harness, and LaunchDarkly, along with mature observability practices.
Ability to design and implement mature deployment and release solutions.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day engineering workflows, including:
AI-assisted code generation, refactoring, and review.
Using AI for technical design, solution exploration, and documentation.
Leveraging AI to plan and structure development and release activities.
Critically evaluating AI-generated outputs and taking ownership of final technical decisions.

Experience working in Agile software teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.
Fluency in English.

Preferred

Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management solutions such as Pulumi.
Experience with observability platforms and monitoring solutions such as New Relic and Grafana.
Experience building web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
Experience developing applications with .NET Core.

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

We are excited by the challenge of doing things differently. At Netcompany we rely on one another and we develop quickly. We are team players. We change societies by creating life-changing IT solutions for variety of customers – from small private companies to large projects in the public sector. Our culture builds on low bureaucracy with a strong focus on high agility and flexibility.

Job Description

Continue your development with us

In Netcompany we focus on your personal and professional development. We offer a structured career model where you can build upon the experiences you bring with you.

When you join us, you will be assigned a personal mentor who will be your sparring partner for your ongoing development as well as for your personal and professional goals. The close relationship with an experienced colleague in the leadership group provides you with concrete insights into the various business areas and responsibilities that match your interests and wishes.

Furthermore, you will participate in our training program, Netcompany Academy, where you will be offered courses and seminars tailored to your career stage. All courses are taught by experienced Netcompany colleagues, ensuring that all content is highly relevant and builds upon your expertise. Participating alongside colleagues from across the company also creates a strong network and provides a solid foundation for your career at Netcompany, both professionally and socially.

Be a part of an inclusive community

At Netcompany, we prioritize community highly. We actively promote an open and welcoming work culture that is built on collaboration and trust, and where there is always room for mutual sparring and support.

It is part of our culture and values that all employees, irrespective of backgrounds, identities, and experiences, are met with understanding and respect, as well as equal opportunities for development and well-being.

You will have the opportunity to learn and collaborate with colleagues from various cultures and nationalities, as we are an international company with offices in many countries.

We provide a shared environment where we engage with each other across departments and projects. Additionally, we offer a wide range of social and professional events that provide you with the best opportunities to expand and build a network already early in your career.

As our new colleague in the Cloud Platform Services team, you will play a key role in agile projects for both large Danish and international customers. You have a unique opportunity to be part of a team responsible for multiple disciplines: Cloud Governance, Cloud Operations, Cloud Center of Excellence, and Cloud Consultancy.

We design and implement business-critical solutions on state-of-the-art infrastructure for customers, where you get hands-on experience with Azure. You will help build and operate our central architecture and solutions, impacting all our cloud solutions across all customers. You will ensure operations in the intersection of infrastructure, security, and the development of customer solutions. Additionally, you will have the opportunity to be lent out to other projects within the organization as a cloud consultant for both shorter and longer periods. All of which we convert to services that enhance and develop our central capability.

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer, your tasks will include:

Monitoring, alerting, automation, and scaling of cloud solutions.
Creating coherence between development, operations, and security in accordance with DevOps and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tasks, e.g., Terraform, Bicep.
Operating with Version controlling system, e.g., Git.
Automation and standardization of Cloud Infrastructure processes (PowerShell/ Azure CLI).

(Euronext: INPST) is Europe's leading out-of-home e-commerce delivery platform, operating over 50,000 automated parcel machines (APMs) and PUDO points across Poland, the UK, France, Italy, and Benelux

, with ambitions that extend into digital wallets, embedded finance, and AI-assisted commerce. This is fintech at logistics scale - and we are just getting started.

Job Description

As you probably know, a lot is happening at InPost. We build products and services that support millions of users and transactions every day. One of the key areas within our ecosystem is InPost Pay, where we develop solutions focused on digital payments, checkout experiences, and sales enablement.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who will take ownership of a growing engineering organization within the Pay domain
. This is an opportunity for a leader who can scale teams, develop engineering leaders, drive technical excellence, and remain a credible partner in architectural and technology discussions.

What will you be responsible for?

Driving the growth and scalability of technology teams supporting payment, checkout, and sales-related products.
Leading an engineering organization of approximately 24–25 engineers across 3 teams:
two teams led through Engineering Managers,
one team managed directly.

Developing Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and senior engineering talent while building a strong leadership pipeline.
Establishing and maintaining technical, architectural, and delivery standards across the entire domain.
Shaping technology strategy in close collaboration with Product, Business, and Engineering stakeholders.
Managing dependencies across teams and ensuring high-quality delivery at scale.
Identifying and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks that impact product development and business outcomes.
Defining and driving the domain's AI adoption strategy, identifying opportunities where AI can improve engineering productivity, software quality, and operational efficiency.
Promoting responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation across engineering teams while measuring business and engineering impact.
Leading the organization through data-driven decision-making by defining, monitoring, and improving domain-level KPIs, OKRs, SLAs, and engineering performance metrics.
Using engineering insights and metrics to continuously improve delivery effectiveness, platform reliability, team productivity, and customer outcomes.
Representing the engineering organization in strategic initiatives and cross-functional leadership discussions.

Qualifications

An ideal profile includes:

10+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and multi-team engineering organizations.
Strong technical foundation gained as a Software Engineer.
Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
Excellent understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and modern backend engineering practices.
Experience working with cloud environments (Google Cloud is a strong advantage).
Experience defining technical standards, SDLC processes, governance models, and engineering operating frameworks.
Ability to translate engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes and effectively communicate with senior stakeholders.

Must have:

Hands-on technical background in the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot) or equivalent enterprise microservices stack (e.g., .NET/C#); sufficient depth to be a credible technical partner in architecture reviews and engineering decisions.
Experience within a production environment.
Experience operating in large-scale product organizations.
Proven success in building and scaling engineering organizations through leaders.
Experience implementing or scaling AI-enabled engineering practices and tools.
Strong understanding of engineering metrics, KPIs, OKRs, and organizational performance management.
Ability to use data and measurable outcomes to drive technology and organizational decisions.

Nice to have:

Experience in fintech, digital payments, checkout platforms, or embedded finance products.
Experience working in organizations building payment processing, commerce, digital wallet, or transaction-heavy platforms.
Background in successful technology scale-ups that have grown both products and engineering organizations rapidly.
Experience in regulated crypto fintech - crypto exchanges, digital asset custodians, or blockchain-based payment infrastructure operating under financial supervision (e.g., MiCA, FCA, or equivalent licensing frameworks).
Demonstrated impact of AI adoption on engineering velocity, developer experience, or software quality.
Experience building management dashboards and using data analytics to drive strategic decisions.

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership bench, extending your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industry.
 InPost is a growing company that offers an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits, training opportunities for self-development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and circular economy every day.

jobs.title: Software Quality Intelligence Engineer
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location: Krakow or Warsaw

Working Model: 3 days/week in the office

The Role:

At Logitech, we build software powering hundreds of thousands of collaboration devices deployed worldwide. Every day, our devices generate millions of telemetry events, crash reports, and quality signals that help us understand how our products perform in the field.

We are looking for a Software Quality Intelligence Engineer to join our Analytics & Quality Engineering team. This role combines hands-on software validation with analytics and investigation to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the data that drives engineering decisions.

You will execute targeted test scenarios to validate that software events, logs, crash reports, and telemetry are generated correctly, verify the accuracy of analytics dashboards and quality metrics, investigate field trends and regressions, and partner with engineering teams to improve software quality through data-driven insights.

This is an opportunity to help define how software quality is measured and continuously improved across Logitech.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

Design and execute manual and automated test scenarios to validate software telemetry, events, logs, crash reports, and analytics across Logitech collaboration devices.
Validate end-to-end data flow from devices through analytics pipelines to dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and integrity.
Analyze telemetry, system logs, and field data to identify software quality trends, regressions, and opportunities for improvement.
Partner with engineering teams to investigate customer issues, perform root cause analysis, and validate software fixes.
Develop automated tools, scripts, and dashboards to monitor software quality, detect anomalies, and improve engineering visibility.
Support release readiness by providing data-driven insights into software stability, reliability, and customer impact.
Leverage AI and modern analytics techniques to accelerate data validation, quality investigations, and root cause analysis.

Key Qualifications:

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in Software QA, Software Analytics or Software Development

Project description

Expert-level engineer designing and building LLM applications and agentic workflows on Azure: RAG pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, MCP tool integration, evaluation, guardrails and cost control. Sets the GenAI engineering standards for the account and is accountable for solution quality against agreed evaluation thresholds.

Responsibilities

Build LLM applications and agent workflows with LangGraph / LangChain / Semantic Kernel on Azure OpenAI (AWS Bedrock / GCP Vertex a plus).
Design RAG pipelines: document ingestion, chunking strategies, embeddings, vector search (Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone), hybrid retrieval and re-ranking.
Integrate enterprise tools and context via Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and function / tool calling; design multi-agent systems.
Engineer, version and test prompts; run offline and online evaluations (accuracy, grounding, hallucination rate) and fine-tuning where justified.
Implement responsible-AI guardrails (content filters, PII redaction, policy checks) and LLM observability (tracing, token accounting, latency).
Optimise token and inference cost (model routing, caching, batching); report against cost budgets.
Document prompts, evaluation results and model choices; mentor engineers adopting GenAI patterns.

Skills

Must have
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years in software or data engineering, of which 3+ in machine learning / NLP and 2+ delivering production LLM applications (RAG, agents) on Azure OpenAI or equivalent.
Expert Python; LangGraph, LangChain and/or Semantic Kernel; asynchronous, event-driven application design.
Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Azure AI Foundry / ML, Functions, Container Apps / AKS, Key Vault, Application Insights.
RAG design: chunking, embeddings, vector databases (Azure AI Search, FAISS, Pinecone), hybrid search, re-ranking.
MCP server / client development, function calling, multi-agent orchestration and state management.
LLM evaluation (RAGAS, promptfoo, Azure AI evaluation or equivalent), fine-tuning (LoRA / PEFT) and model selection.
Guardrails (Azure AI Content Safety, NeMo Guardrails or similar), LLM observability (LangSmith, OpenTelemetry), FinOps for inference.

AWS Bedrock or GCP Vertex AI.
Semantic caching, model distillation, small-language-model deployment.
Azure AI Engineer Associate (AI-102) or equivalent.
Experience in financial services, sovereign wealth / investment holding or other regulated enterprise environments.
Experience working with distributed teams (onsite UAE with nearshore India / offshore Poland squads).

English: C1 Advanced

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

What You’ll Actually Be Doing

As part of a cross-functional product team, you’ll take meaningful ownership across the full software lifecycle:

Build & scale core services: Design, build, and ship robust backend services, APIs, and business-critical workflows using modern C# and .NET.
Shape system architecture: Drive decisions on scalability, resilience, and performance for high-throughput distributed systems.
Turn requirements into reality: Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to translate complex business needs into pragmatic technical solutions.
Elevate the team: Mentor colleagues, conduct thoughtful code reviews, and share knowledge to help the engineering group grow.
Own production health: Champion automated testing, clean documentation, and reliable deployment practices so we ship with confidence.

Qualifications

Who you are:

You’re an experienced engineer who enjoys untangling complex problems and balances engineering excellence with pragmatic delivery:

Backend depth: 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, with deep expertise in C# and modern .NET.
Distributed systems: Practical experience designing clean REST APIs, message queues, event-driven workflows, and asynchronous communication patterns.
Data fluency: Strong background with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL), query optimization, and ORMs like EF Core or Dapper.
Cloud & DevOps: Experience deploying and managing containerized services (Docker/Kubernetes) in cloud environments, ideally Microsoft Azure.
Observability & troubleshooting: Skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex production issues using logs, metrics, and distributed tracing.
Pragmatic tooling: Comfortable leveraging AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to move faster, while applying sharp judgment to ensure security and code quality.
Clear communication: Fluent in English, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs to both engineering peers and non-technical partners.
Bonus points: Prior experience with FinTech, banking, payments, or ledger/accounting systems is a strong plus.

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Sweden.

Du blir en del av utvecklingsteamet inom Sveas affärsområde Payments, som erbjuder betal- och finansieringslösningar för både e-handel och fysisk handel. Teamet arbetar med att utveckla och underhålla affärsområdets egenutvecklade system och applikationer. Vi utvecklar främst i .NET C#, React och Vue.js

Vem är du?

Vi letar efter dig som brinner för hög kodkvalitet, tycker om att lösa komplexa problem och trivs med att omvandla idéer till lösningar som gör vardagen enklare för våra kunder. Du är självgående och gillar en föränderlig miljö och kan snabbt sätta dig in i komplexa problem samt ge förslag på tekniska lösningar. Du vill förstå affären och bidra till den tekniska riktningen framåt. Vi ser att du är en engagerad lagspelare som trivs med att arbeta mot gemensamma mål och ser styrkan i samarbete. Du är också kommunikativ och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap till kollegor i och utanför teamet.

Erfarenheter och kvalifikationer

Mycket goda kunskaper i .NET C#
Mycket goda kunskaper i React (kunskaper i Vue.js är meriterande).
Goda kunskaper inom kvalitetssäkring och automatisering av test
Högskoleutbildning inom systemvetenskap eller motsvarande
Minst 5+ års erfarenhet av arbete inom systemutveckling
Flytande kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både tal och skrift

Meriterande med erfarenhet av att jobba inom Bank & Finans med insyn i regulatoriska krav samt förmåga att förstå verksamhetskrav och omsätta i kundnytta samt erfarenhet av arbete i tvärfunktionella team.

Om Svea

Svea är en finansiell koncern med över 2000 anställda och verksamhet i flertalet europeiska länder. Med mer än 40 års erfarenhet är vi stolta över att erbjuda innovativa och hållbara finansiella lösningar till våra kunder. Svea präglas av en familjär företagskultur där varje medarbetare bidrar med sin unika kompetens och engagemang. Vår företagskultur betonar gemenskap, handlingskraft, och balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Välkommen att följa med oss på vår spännande resa!

Trivs du bäst i en miljö där idéer snabbt blir verklighet? Hos Knutwall blir du en del av ett litet utvecklingsteam med stort mandat och nära samarbete med verksamheten. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta brett, påverka tekniska beslut och utveckla lösningar som gör skillnad på riktigt.

Din vardag

Som Fullstack-Utvecklare hos Knutwall blir du en del av ett litet och erfaret utvecklingsteam där du arbetar brett över hela företagets systemmiljö. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingscykeln, från kravdialog och utveckling till test, release och uppföljning.

Som Fullstack-Utvecklare kommer du att arbeta med både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling av Knutwalls egenutvecklade system. Cirka 3-5 års erfarenhet av systemutveckling
Goda kunskaper inom C# och .NET
Erfarenhet av SQL
Flytande svenska i tal och skrift

Angular
WinForms
Azure eller andra molnplattformar
Azure DevOps

Innehar certifieringen Dynamics 365 Business Central Developer Associate

Vår förmånspolicy är utvecklad för att möta både dina professionella och personliga behov. I vårt omfattande förmånspaket ingår friskvårdsbidrag, tjänstepension och frivillig sjukvårdsförsäkring. Vår ersättningsmodell består av en konkurrenskraftig fast del och en rörlig del som ger dig möjlighet att påverka din lön baserat på din prestation och ambition. The custom-developed applications are built according to a target architecture and operate within an event-driven, distributed, service-oriented architecture using microservices.

and Confluence

In this role, you will:
Ensure the quality of applications and systems, primarily through automated testing.
Plan and execute tests, create test cases, link test cases to requirements, report progress, and perform troubleshooting.
Conduct frontend and GUI testing.
Manage test environments and create complex test data related to release builds.
Test third-party integrations, including advanced test chains involving system components across different organizations, both internally and externally.

Act as a support, mentor, and coach within testing, both for other testers and other system development roles.

Continuously contribute to knowledge transfer.

Have worked with testing and quality assurance of custom-developed applications and systems through functional and non-functional testing, regression testing, and integration testing based on defined acceptance criteria, including traceability to requirements and changes, for at least 10 years within the last 15 years.

Have used Confluence for documentation and possess strong expertise in the tool.

Support the manager and product owner with technical direction, architecture input, and solution design.
Act as a senior technical expert who helps guide decisions and supports the team in building strong, scalable solutions.

Solid experience in IoT connectivity and remote access solutions

Experience designing scalable, reliable connectivity solutions

Solid coding/scripting skills (e.g., PowerShell, Bash, Python) and experience with Infrastructure as Code

The opportunity to be part of our next phase of growth and expansion, backed by strategic private equity investment
Competitive compensation and benefits package including pension, flex hours, wellness allowances and more
Hybrid working options

Pacera is redefining financial operations for the Office of the CFO — powering planning, financial close, consolidation, and reporting through one unified platform, trusted by 700+ organisations and 70,000+ users across more than 140 countries.

jobs.description:
Senior utvikler med .NET-erfaring – data, analyse og AI

Har du solid erfaring med .NET og lyst til å jobbe tettere på data? Hos Handelshøyskolen BI får du bruke utviklerkompetansen din til å videreutvikle en skybasert analyseplattform som gir bedre innsikt og beslutningsstøtte.

BI har allerede etablert forretningskritiske digitale produkter som brukes av titusenvis hver dag. Teknologimiljøet er produktorientert og jobber tett med virksomheten. Her får du påvirke arkitektur, teknologivalg og hvordan løsningene utvikles.

Rollen
Du blir en del av BIs analyseplattform-team. Teamet arbeider med dataflyt på tvers av systemer, analyse- og rapporteringsløsninger og en plattform for innsikt, prediksjon og beslutningsstøtte. Dere utforsker også hvordan AI og maskinlæring kan brukes i praksis.

Dette er en rolle for deg som liker å forstå hele veien fra datakilde til løsningene folk faktisk bruker. Kanskje har du jobbet mye med .NET og integrasjoner, og ønsker å bruke den erfaringen i et miljø der data og analyse står sentralt. Du får ta tekniske valg, jobbe selvstendig og samarbeide tett med både teknologer og brukere.

Teknologiene omfatter blant annet Python, Scala, PySpark/Databricks, Power BI og SQL. Erfaring med .NET, særlig C# og ASP.NET Core, er verdifull. Du trenger ikke å ha jobbet med alle teknologiene fra før, men du må ha lyst til å sette deg inn i dem.

Hvem ser vi etter?
Vi tror du vil trives i rollen hvis du:
har flere års erfaring som utvikler, gjerne med .NET
er interessert i dataflyt, analyse og AI, og ønsker å utvikle deg videre på disse områdene
har erfaring med noen av teknologiene i plattformen, eller relevant erfaring som gjør at du raskt kan lære dem
forstår hvordan data hentes inn, bearbeides og gjøres nyttige for andre
liker å ta ansvar for tekniske valg og samarbeide i tverrfaglige team
har bachelor eller master i informatikk, datateknologi eller tilsvarende
behersker norsk flytende og er komfortabel med engelsk som arbeidsspråk

Erfaring med analyseplattformer, dataintegrasjon, sky eller AI-relaterte løsninger er en fordel.
Hvorfor BI?

Hos BI får du reell påvirkning på hvordan data brukes i en stor kunnskapsorganisasjon. Du blir del av et stabilt fagmiljø med rom for kunnskapsdeling og kompetanseutvikling gjennom kurs, BI-studier og sertifiseringer.

Som fullstack-utvikler blir du en del av CFO IT, et fagmiljø med ansvar for utvikling av systemer og modeller innen blant annet Solvens II og IFRS 17. Teamet utvikler skreddersydde løsninger for CFO-området og samarbeider tett med både forretningsmiljøer og andre teknologiteam på tvers av konsernet.

Hos oss får du jobbe med moderne teknologi, stor faglig bredde og spennende problemstillinger i skjæringspunktet mellom finans, data og programvareutvikling. Du får muligheten til å påvirke både løsninger, arbeidsmetoder og teknologivalg i et miljø som er opptatt av kontinuerlig forbedring og læring.

Arbeidsoppgaver
Delta i hele programvareutviklingssyklusen, fra design og utvikling til drift og videreutvikling

Utvikle og vedlikeholde skreddersydde løsninger for CFO-området

Modernisere plattformer og bidra til forbedring av arbeidsprosesser og utviklingsmetodikk

Utforske og ta i bruk nye AI-verktøy og teknologier i utviklingsarbeidet

Bidra med teknisk sparring og støtte til andre utviklere

Samarbeide tett med fagområder i CFO for å utvikle løsninger som skaper verdi for brukerne

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter deg som har minst tre års erfaring med programvareutvikling og god forståelse for hele utviklingsløpet fra idé til produksjon. Du har erfaring med C#, og det er en fordel om du også har jobbet med Azure, GitHub og SQL. Interesse for moderne teknologi, skyplattformer og AI-verktøy er viktig for å lykkes i rollen. Erfaring fra finansbransjen er ikke et krav.

Personlige egenskaper

Du er nysgjerrig, løsningsorientert og opptatt av kvalitet i arbeidet ditt. Du trives med å samarbeide med andre, deler gjerne kunnskap og motiveres av å bidra til både teamets og organisasjonens utvikling. Samtidig evner du å jobbe selvstendig, ta initiativ og drive oppgaver fremover. Du liker å lære nye ting, utfordre etablerte løsninger og utforske ny teknologi.

Vår kultur

Hos oss blir du en del av et miljø med høy faglig kompetanse, stort engasjement og kort vei fra idé til handling. Du får jobbe med spennende utfordringer, moderne teknologi og kolleger som deler kunnskap og løfter hverandre.

Vi tror de beste løsningene skapes gjennom samarbeid, nysgjerrighet og vilje til å lære. Derfor får du stor variasjon i oppgaver, gode utviklingsmuligheter og muligheten til å utforske ny teknologi og AI i praksis.

Har du driv, lærelyst og interesse for teknologi, gir vi deg verktøyene og støtten du trenger for å lykkes.

Hvorfor velge Storebrand?

Hos oss får du rom til å ta plass, bli hørt og utvikle deg i et konsern med mange muligheter. Vi er stolte av kulturen vår, drivkraften vår og den felles retningen vi jobber mot: En fremtid å glede seg til.

Vi tror på verdien av ulike perspektiver og bakgrunner, og jobber aktivt for et inkluderende og mangfoldig miljø. Det blir lagt merke til: I 2025 rangerte Equileap Storebrand som nummer én i Norge og blant de tre beste selskapene i verden på likestilling. I 2026 vant vi ODA Champions.

Som fremtidsoptimister tenker vi langsiktig og investerer i løsninger som styrker oss og samfunnet rundt oss. Det er én grunn til at vi er ett av to norske selskaper i Dow Jones Best-in-Class World Index.

Hos oss på Lysaker jobber du sentralt, med gode kollektivmuligheter, sykkelparkering og garderober. Du får helseforsikring, tilgang til kiropraktor og fysioterapeut på kontoret, og gode treningsmuligheter i Storebrand Arena. I tillegg tilbyr vi en meget god pensjonsordning, gunstige forsikringer og boliglån med subsidiert rente.

Søknadsfrist: 15. oktober

Kontaktperson:
Anders Bechet, Leder CFO IT
Telefon:
+47 903 66 498
E-post:
anders.bechet@storebrand.no

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!

Å søke jobb i Storebrand skal være enkelt. Derfor trenger du ikke å skrive et søknadsbrev. Vi ønsker kun din CV og svar på noen få spørsmål i søknadsprosessen.

Vi tror på at mangfold styrker oss, og ønsker alle kvalifiserte søkere uansett bakgrunn og erfaring velkommen. Trenger du tilpasninger i søknadsprosessen? Ikke nøl med å gi oss beskjed – slik at vi sammen kan finne en løsning som fungerer for deg.

Storebrand samarbeider med Semac for bakgrunnssjekk av aktuelle kandidater. Bakgrunnssjekken utføres etter samtykke fra deg som søker og innebærer at vi verifiserer CV og annen søknadsdokumentasjon i forbindelse med ansettelsen. The Azure Integration Architect is a senior technical expert responsible for designing and governing enterprise-grade integration solutions on the Microsoft Azure platform. Architecture & Design

Define integration patterns such as event-driven, pub/sub, request-reply, choreography, and orchestration
Develop and maintain architecture reference models, solution blueprints, and technical standards

Ensure architectures are designed for high availability, fault tolerance, and disaster recovery

Solution Development & Oversight

Define API design guidelines including versioning, security policies, throttling, and documentation standards

Governance & Standards

Operations & Continuous Improvement

Identify performance bottlenecks and recommend optimization strategies
Stay current with Microsoft Azure roadmap and emerging integration trends, incorporating relevant innovations

Required Qualifications

Deep expertise in Azure Integration Services: Logic Apps (Standard & Consumption), Azure API Management, Azure Service Bus, Azure Event Grid, Azure Event Hubs, and Azure Data Factory

jobs.title: Director Digital Platform
jobs.description:
At Bulk, our mission is to build sustainable infrastructure that supports the digital society of tomorrow. As one of the leading providers of sustainable, high-performance data center solutions in the Nordics, we design and operate infrastructure that powers artificial intelligence and the digital society – efficiently, securely, and with 100% renewable energy. We are now looking to hire a Director of Digital Platform to play a central role in building the data and software platform that our AI and digital ambitions rest on.

Bulk's AI & Digital function exists to leverage AI and digital to improve operations, save costs, and automate work. You will own the foundation the rest of it builds on, both its architecture and its build: the data-and-software platform behind every product surface and every AI agent on the team. You will stand up the data layer: live readings off Bulk's data center sites, data from the core business systems, and integrations with partner and OEM digital offerings, plus the interfaces that let AI agents act safely and the developer tooling the team relies on.

Reporting to the VP AI & Digital, you will ship in thin slices, own the build-versus-buy calls, enforce governance at the interface layer alongside Cyber Security, and lead the platform team hands-on, staying close to the code.

What you'll do:

As our Director Digital Platform, your key responsibilities will be:

Platform and data

Stand up the platform that pulls live readings off the data center sites and turns that data into something the rest of the team can build on.
Ship in thin slices, starting with one site, one use case, one connector.
Integrate data from core business systems such as ERP and CRM, in close collaboration with IT, who run, maintain and upgrade them.
Connect partner and OEM digital offerings so their data and capabilities are available through the platform.

Architecture and technology choices

Own the platform architecture: how the layers fit together, what the interfaces look like, and how it holds up as Bulk goes from one site to many.
Own the build-versus-buy decisions on the platform layer, and coordinate with existing systems vendors so the team doesn't duplicate what is already there.
Take a position on the platform's cloud direction and keep the cost of running it under control as it grows.

Interfaces, governance and security

Design the interface layer as the place the rules are enforced: who can log in, what gets recorded, rate limits, and who is allowed to see which data.
Partner with Cyber Security so the controls on platform data and access are designed in, not reviewed after.
Deliver interfaces for customers and partners to pull relevant live data, service-level status and incident events.

Team and ways of working

Build and lead a focused platform team, including DevOps , backend development, and data product development, with consultants brought in for surge work.
Run the sandbox where colleagues across Bulk prototype and prove ideas safely and own the engineer-led path that promotes a proven proof of concept into production.
Work closely with the program leads for operations, projects and the commercial side, who will build on the platform you own.

Who are you?

You are a hands-on engineering leader who stays close to the code rather than managing from a distance. You are pragmatic about scope and ship working slices, not cathedrals. Your technical judgment is strong, you make architectural calls and own them, and you de-risk with smaller initiatives while keeping the bigger picture in mind. You are fluent in a modern engineering toolchain and in agentic workflows, infrastructure included, and you get far more out of a small team because of it. In a function that is still taking shape, you find your own way, stay curious, take up space, and carry things through.

What you bring:

Minimum 10 years in software engineering and technology, and still hands-on. You read, write and review code fluently, and architecture and delivery calls are made from inside the code, not above it.
Proven experience standing up an industrial IoT platform in an industrial enterprise, in production, not designed on paper.
Strong working command of a modern cloud platform, Azure, AWS or Google Cloud, as someone who builds on it rather than buys it: networking, identity, data services and cost control.
Experience integrating core business systems such as ERP and CRM, alongside the IT organization that runs them.
Experience standing up and running infrastructure with agentic tooling, including AgentOps: operating the platform through agents, not only writing code with their help.
Experience leading a small, senior engineering team while staying close to the code.
Good understanding of OT systems and the protocols the data comes over, such as SCADA, building management systems, OPC UA, Modbus and MQTT. Familiarity with data center, energy or other physical infrastructure environments is an advantage.
Higher education in engineering, computer science or a related technical discipline. Extensive relevant experience may compensate for formal education.
Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in a Scandinavian language is considered an advantage.

Why join us?

Build Bulk's digital platform from the ground up, and the team around it.
Influence how key operational processes are shaped and developed.
Become part of a growing organization with a strong sustainability mission.
Work with critical infrastructure that supports the digital society of tomorrow.
Collaborate with highly skilled colleagues across disciplines and locations.

What we offer our Bulkies:

A dynamic, growth-oriented workplace with a strong sustainability focus
Comprehensive insurance (health, travel – business & private) and annual health check
Additional time off during Easter and Christmas
Monthly contribution to home internet costs and sustainable commuting
Annual wellness allowance to support an active lifestyle
Fully paid parental leave

Take the next step in your career and join us as we build the future of digital infrastructure in Norway and beyond!

Next steps

We review applicants continuously, and we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. To apply, please upload your CV and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience and why you are the ideal candidate for this role.

We conduct background checks on all hires. We may also require you to obtain security clearance and a police certificate of conduct.

Bulk aim for gender balance and a diverse workforce. We do not discriminate against gender, race, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, pregnancy and/or disability. We appreciate the time you have spent reading this, and if the role aligns with your aspirations, we encourage you to apply!

Racing to bring sustainable infrastructure to a global audience!

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer
who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

If you're excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Your Mission

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Systems

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Design API-First Architecture

Create robust APIs that connect internal services, booking channels, third-party providers, and customer systems.

Integrate the Ecosystem

Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other strategic partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Scale Infrastructure

Deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure designed for reliability, performance, and global growth across multiple property management businesses.

Solve Complex Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
Dynamic pricing intelligence
Smart lock access and key management
Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Move Fast and Own Delivery

Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Bring senior engineering judgment to technical decisions, code reviews, and the reliability of the systems you build.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

Python
FastAPI
React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe
Docker
GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

Strong experience building and owning production-grade software systems
Experience with FastAPI, Python, React, or similar frameworks
Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
Experience designing scalable backend systems and reliable data models
The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions
Strong problem-solving skills and a product mindset
Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
A bias toward action, shipping, and learning from real users
The ability to balance delivery speed with maintainability and reliability

Bonus Points For Experience With

Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

Core short-term rental workflows are automated through systems you've built
Property managers spend less time on manual administration
Reservations, availability, payments, and operational data move reliably between systems
New integrations are deployed and maintained reliably
AI-powered workflows become part of customers’ everyday operations
The platform supports more operators and properties while maintaining reliability and performance
Base360.ai helps customers grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Extreme Ownership

Have the freedom and responsibility to make technical decisions and deliver systems that matter.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
You prefer a narrowly defined role with limited product involvement
You need detailed instructions for every task
You avoid ownership and accountability
You're comfortable shipping work without taking responsibility for its quality

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer with Next.js
jobs.description:
Would you like to make an impact on our 3.8 million customers across the Nordic region? You could become one of us in the Digital services unit, where modern technologies, smart design, and user experience are key drivers. We are now looking for a motivated and talented individual to join one of our teams.

About The Role

We're excited to introduce Next.js into our development landscape and are looking for someone with strong expertise in the framework to help lead the journey. You will act as a catalyst for adoption, mentoring team members, promoting best practices, and strengthening the team's overall capability in Next.js.

Working in one of our cross-functional agile teams, you will help design and deliver web services that provide smooth customer experiences across the Nordic countries.

Together with your team, you will build web solutions and APIs using Azure-hosted services, leveraging C#, .NET, ASP.NET MVC, Web APIs, JavaScript, React, Next.js, and Razor.

Test automation and continuous integration are a natural part of your workflow. You will also collaborate with business stakeholders to understand requirements and refine user stories.

We offer

Benefits

In the same way that we place high demands on you as an employee, we also expect you to place high demands on us as an employer. Here are some of the benefits of working at If:

An including work environment where everyone is welcome
Career and development opportunities in the biggest insurance company in the Nordics
Social activities, as well as highly skilled professional environment
Possibility of hybrid workplace
Health promoting workplace with e.g., wellness allowance and various sports activities
Great insurance benefits
Lunch benefit

About The Team

Our web applications provide Nordic customers with modern self-service solutions for managing insurance, claims, and payments. The team continuously improves these services and develops APIs that support other digital channels, including mobile apps.

You will join a cross-functional agile team with colleagues in Turku, Espoo, Riga, and Stockholm. The team is supportive, ambitious, and committed to continuous improvement. As part of the Oasis tribe, you will help deliver services that keep customers well supported, informed, and correctly insured across the Nordics. Although the team works across multiple locations, there are regular opportunities to meet colleagues in person.

You will also be part of a chapter, a community of developers with similar competencies. Chapters help ensure our teams have the technical capabilities they need today and in the future. Together with your peers, you will shape learning topics, share knowledge, and grow your expertise with support from your Chapter Lead.

Beyond your immediate team, you will be part of a broader developer community across Espoo, Turku, and Riga, providing plenty of opportunities to learn, collaborate, and connect with colleagues. Read more about our tech community.

Read more about our tech community.

Who are you?

You are passionate about development in an agile environment and contributing to software development and operations initiatives in your team. You enjoy sharing your Next.js expertise, coaching colleagues, and helping them build confidence in the framework. You are motivated by quality and good design and are always eager to learn more.

You Also Have

Multiple years of experience in software development (mid or senior level)
Deep knowledge of backend software development with C#/.NET
Good understanding of REST API development (.NET)
Front-end development experience with React, Next.js, TypeScript/JavaScript
Experience with Azure, Git environments, pull requests, and code reviews
Solid understanding of HTML and CSS (tailwind)
Experience with integration of third-party services via API
Strong communication skills to articulate complex concepts and logic to non-technical stakeholders and cross-functional teams
Problem-solving and adaptability, including critical thinking and resourceful solution design
Strong collaboration skills and comfort working with practices such as code reviews and pair programming
Fluent English skills, both spoken and written
Familiarity with GitHub Copilot, other AI assistants or agentic development is an advantage
Experience with SQL Server, Entity Framework, or NoSQL
Relevant bachelor's or master's degree, or equivalent work experience

Additional Facts And The Recruitment Process

Application deadline:
Screening and interviewing will start immediately. However, the application deadline is 11.10.2026.

To apply for the position:
Please attach your CV

Work location:
Espoo or Turku (Finland)

Travelling:
Occasional travel within the Nordic and Baltic countries

Start:
As soon as possible or by agreement

For more information, please contact Andris Magazeins, Chapter Lead, andris.magazeins@if.lv

Background checks for this position will be done in accordance with the law in the country of employment.

We look forward to your application!
