jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (AI & Modern Web)
jobs.description:
Haluatko viettää työpäiväsi vaikuttavissa projekteissa yhteisössä, joka tukee ammatillista kehittymistäsi? Senior Full Stack Developerina Nitorilla ratkaiset asiakkaiden liiketoimintakriittisiä haasteita moderneilla teknologioilla - frontendistä backendiin, ja yhä enemmän tekoälypohjaisten featureiden ja agenttisten ratkaisujen parissa, jotka muuttavat asiakkaidemme tapaa toimia.

🚀 Lyhyt kuvaus työstäsi

Senior Full Stack Developerina Nitorilla tehtäväsi voivat vaihdella selainpohjaisten käyttöliittymien ohjelmoinnista integraatioihin ja taustajärjestelmäkehitykseen.

Merkittävässä roolissa on asiakkaidemme liiketoiminnallisen fokuksen sulauttaminen kirjoittamaasi koodiin. On tärkeää, että rakentamissasi ratkaisuissa yhdistyvät suorituskyky, kustannustehokkuus ja yksinkertaisen kaunis, ylläpidettävä koodi.

Työkaluina käytössäsi ovat asiakasprojektista riippuen JavaScript, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin, C#, pilviteknologiat (AWS, Azure tai GCP), CI/CD-työkalut ja tietokannat. Toisinaan pääset hyödyntämään myös mahdollisia funktionaalisen ohjelmoinnin taitojasi, esim. Clojuren parissa.

Moderni ohjelmistokehitys tarkoittaa rakentamista tekoälyn kanssa. Asiakasprojektimme etenevät nopeasti tähän suuntaan - LLM-pohjaisista featureista agenttisiin ratkaisuihin, jotka muuttavat tiimien toimintaa. Jos olet jo käyttänyt tekoälytyökaluja kehitystyössäsi tai rakentanut palveluita, jotka hyödyntävät kielimalleja, löydät meiltä projekteja joissa viet tätä osaamista pidemmälle. Ja jos tekoälypohjainen kehitys kiinnostaa, mutta sopivat projektit ovat toistaiseksi puuttuneet, projektimme ja yhteisömme vievät sinua eteenpäin.

Sovellamme työssämme DevOps-mallin mukaisesti testiautomaatiota, jatkuvaa toimitusta ja muita ketteriä kehitysmenetelmiä. Yksittäisen menetelmän seuraamista tärkeämpää meille on kuitenkin itsenäinen ajattelu ja pragmaattinen tapa soveltaa hyväksi havaittuja käytäntöjä.

Vielä lisää konkretiaa

Asiakasprojektimme ovat tyypillisesti haastavia ja samalla ammatillisesti palkitsevia kokonaisuuksia, jotka tarjoavat kokeneelle ohjelmistokehittäjälle mahdollisuuden sekä hyödyntää että syventää osaamistaan. Projektien kesto on usein vuodesta useampaan vuoteen riippuen omista toiveistasi. Useimmissa projekteissa toimit osana asiakkaan kehitystiimiä, jossa on mukana myös useampi muu kokenut nitorilainen. Tutustu tulevan kollegasi Marion Bhuptan tarinaan ja miten hän on kasvanut kokeneeksi full stack -asiantuntijaksi Nitorilla.

Kiinnostaako lukea lisää teknogiavalinnoistamme? Kehittäjäkyselymme 2026 paljastaa ajankohtaiset teknologiatrendit.

AI-pohjainen kehitys ei ole meillä vain slogan - 73% nitorilaisista käyttää tekoälytyökaluja päivittäin. Lue lisää AI-kyselystämme !

✅ Mitä sinä voisit tuoda mukanasi?

Tässä tehtävässä loistat, kun sinulla on syvä ymmärrys siitä, miten modernit web-sovellukset ja digitaaliset palvelut toimivat ja rakentuvat. Hallitset koko kehitysketjun frontendistä backendiin ja ymmärrät miten ne toimivat yhdessä.

Emme ole tarkkoja kokemusvuosien suhteen, mutta olemme huomanneet, että 8+ vuotta kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä erilaisten palvelujen ja tuotteiden parissa auttaa sinua toimimaan asiakasprojekteissasi lisäarvoa tuovana asiantuntijana.

Sinulla on vahva osaaminen useammasta ohjelmointikielestä ja vähintään yhdestä pilviteknologiasta (AWS, Azure tai GCP). Asiakasprojekteissamme ovat yleisesti käytössä muun muassa JavaScript, Node.js, React, TypeScript, Java, Kotlin ja .NET. Lisäksi sinulla on kokemusta CI/CD-työkaluista ja tietokannoista.

Koska full stack -kehittäjän työ on monipuolista ja vaatii yhteistyötä eri sidosryhmien kanssa, arvostamme konsultatiivista ja asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa. Sinun tulee ymmärtää asiakkaan tarpeita ja osata kommunikoida teknisistä ratkaisuista. Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen osaaminen on tärkeää, sillä asiakkaita on sekä kotimaassa että kansainvälisesti.

Tekoälypuolella arvostamme kokemusta agenttisten tekoälytyökalujen, kuten Claude Coden, käytöstä osana kehitystyötä sekä käytännön kokemusta palveluiden tai featurejen rakentamisesta LLM-rajapintoja hyödyntäen. Uteliaisuus siitä, mihin tekoälykehitys menossa, on tärkeää - olipa kyse sitten agenttiframeworkeista kuten LangChainin Deep Agents tai OpenAI Agents SDK, observability-työkaluista kuten LangSmith tai tekoälyalustoista kuten Microsoft AI Foundry, AWS Bedrock tai Google Vertex AI.

Eduksi on, jos olet miettinyt, miltä CI/CD näyttää, kun järjestelmäsi on ei-deterministinen - miten esimerkiksi testaat ja evaluoit LLM-pohjaisia featureita luotettavasti.

Et kuitenkaan tarvitse kokemusta kaikesta tästä - mutta jos agenttinen, GenAI-pohjainen featurekehitys innostaa sinua, tarjoamme siihen erinomaiset mahdollisuudet.

🏆 Mitä jos valitsisitkin meidät?

Uskomme, että rekrytoinnissa ei ole kyse siitä, että yritys valitsee uuden työntekijän. Sinä lopulta teet valinnan. Ja me voimme sinua siinä auttaa.

Sinun kannattaa olla meihin yhteydessä, jos:
haluat työskennellä merkityksellisten, pitkäaikaisten asiakassuhteiden ja -projektien parissa - myös projekteissa, joissa tekoäly on todellinen osa sitä, mitä rakennat
rinnallasi työskentelevät osaavat kollegat, erinomaiset kehittymismahdollisuudet sekä optimaaliset työolosuhteet ovat sinulle tärkeitä
koet, että yhteisöllisyys ja kollegoille hyvän tahtominen ovat työelämässä merkityksellisiä arvoja
sinusta on ihan ok tehdä normityöaikaa ja huolehtia, että vapaat ja työt pysyvät balanssissa
haluat työskennellä koko kehitysketjussa fronttendistä backendiin

Työskentelyäsi ja arkeasi tukevat meillä monimuotoiset edut ja mahdollisuudet, esimerkiksi:
Voit käyttää 10 % työajastasi ammatilliseen kehittymiseen
7100 € "Rautapankki" työväline- ja kotitoimistohankintoihin, joka täydentyy kuukausittain
Täydet palkalliset lomat heti työsuhteen alusta riippumatta aloitusajankohdasta
500-2000 € bonus jokaisesta suorittamastasi sertifikaatista
Yhteisiä matkoja, tapahtumia ja harrastusryhmiä aina juoksuklubista lautapelikerhoon

❓Onko mielessäsi kysymyksiä? Pohdituttaako jokin seikka?

Olisimme todella kiinnostuneita kuulemaan sinusta lisää. Kerro, millaista askelta olet urallasi ottamassa, ja katsotaan, miten me voisimme sinua auttaa. Lähetä meille LinkedIn-profiilisi tai CV:si. Lisätietoja voit kysyä People Partneriltamme Ella Raskilalta (ella.raskila@nitor.com). Haluamme varmistaa, että saat kaiken tarvitsemasi tiedon sinulle tärkeän päätöksen tekemiseksi.

👥 Me kuuntelemme sinua

Haluamme tarjota asiantuntijoillemme parhaan mahdollisen työpaikan ja tukea sinun osaamisesi kehittymistä. Nitorilla juuri sinä, ainutlaatuiset taitosi ja henkilökohtaiset kiinnostuksen kohteesi määrittävät urasi suunnan.

Kiehtovat projektit, luontainen uteliaisuutemme ja kollegojesi tuki motivoivat sinua jatkuvassa oppimisessa. Osallistut mielenkiintoisiin koulutuksiin, tapahtumiin ja konferensseihin. Lisäksi voit käyttää osan työajastasi uuden oppimiseen, yhteisömme kehittämiseen sekä sinua inspiroiviin pro bono -projekteihin.

Meillä urapolkusi ei ole ennalta määrätty – päinvastoin, kannustamme sinua tutkimaan kiinnostuksen kohteitasi ilman turhaa hierarkiaa ja byrokratiaa. Nitorilla äänesi kuuluu.
Toimintatapamme perustuvat luottamukseen, avoimuuteen ja toistemme kunnioittamiseen. Jokainen nitorilainen tuo oman lisänsä yrityksen toimintaan. Arvostamme ja vaalimme erilaisuutta sekä sen tuomaa lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme.

🎯 Lyhyesti Nitorista – toivottavasti sinunkin tulevasta työpaikastasi

Jokainen nitorilainen on pragmaattinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen tiimipelaaja, joka ei tyydy oletuksiin. Meille ominaista ovat todella korkea ammattitaito ja ylpeys niin omasta kuin kollegoidemmekin työstä.

Yli 250 asiantuntijaamme toimivat Helsingissä ja Tampereella, yhdistäen monipuoliset osaamisensa merkityksellisten vaikutusten saavuttamiseksi. Olemme ylpeitä työntekijälähtöisestä kulttuuristamme ja aidosta sitoutumisestamme ihmistemme kasvuun – tunnustuksena tästä meidät on palkittu Great Place to Work -sertifikaatilla sekä valittu Suomen vetovoimaisimmaksi työnantajabrändiksi .

Visiomme on selkeä: olla alan halutuin työpaikka, jossa menestys syntyy työntekijöiden ja asiakkaiden hyvinvoinnista ja tyytyväisyydestä. Jatkamme kasvuamme IT-alan asiakastyytyväisyyden suunnannäyttäjänä tuottaen erinomaista lisäarvoa asiakkaillemme ( lue, miten ainutlaatuinen asiakaskokemus ruokkii kasvuamme ).

jobs.description:
Title: .NET Developer (C#, WinForms/WPF, Oracle)

Location: Espoo or Tampere, Finland (100% On-site)

Contract Duration: 01 Oct 2026 – 31 Dec 2026 (Freelance B2B, extension potential)

Workload: 100% (37.5 hrs/week)

Position Summary:

We are seeking an experienced .NET Developer
for a 3-month freelance B2B engagement in Espoo or Tampere.

In this role, you will focus on maintaining and modernizing client/server desktop applications and backend web services across .NET Framework, .NET Core, and Oracle database environments.

Key Responsibilities:

Maintain and develop client/server applications using C#, Windows Forms, WPF, and WCF services.
Implement and update web services, REST/SOAP APIs, and ASP.NET Web API integrations hosted on IIS.

Ohjata kehitystiimejä teknisissä ratkaisuissa ja tukea toteutuksen onnistumista koko projektin ajan.
Määritellä sovelluskehityksen hallintamalleja, ympäristöstrategioita sekä käyttöönotto- ja ylläpitokäytäntöjä.
Arvioida ja suunnitella tekoälyn hyödyntämistä osana liiketoimintaprosesseja ja digitaalisia palveluja.
Kuvata ja esitellä ratkaisuvaihtoehtoja eri sidosryhmille ymmärrettävästi.

Osaamisvaatimukset

Kokemusta Microsoft Power Platform -ratkaisujen ja pilvipalveluiden arkkitehtuurisuunnittelusta.
Ymmärrys sovelluskehityksen elinkaaren hallinnasta, DevOps-toimintatavoista ja ympäristöjen hallinnasta.
Kokemusta yritysratkaisujen integraatioarkkitehtuureista ja järjestelmien yhteentoimivuuden suunnittelusta.
Kyky määritellä tietoturvaan, käyttöoikeuksiin, tietosuojaan ja hallintamalleihin liittyviä ratkaisuja.
Kokemusta tekoäly- ja automaatioratkaisujen hyödyntämisestä osana laajempia liiketoimintaratkaisuja.
Ymmärrys käyttäjäkeskeisestä suunnittelusta ja kyky huomioida loppukäyttäjän tarpeet ratkaisujen suunnittelussa.
Erinomaiset vuorovaikutus- ja fasilitointitaidot sekä kyky kommunikoida teknisiä ratkaisuja erilaisille kohderyhmille.
Käytännön kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja modernien kehitysvälineiden hyödyntämisestä.

Microsoft Power Platform

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for an ambitious Product Engineer
who wants to turn real customer problems into intuitive, reliable software. You'll work closely with founders, designers, and operators to identify what matters, build solutions, and improve them based on how people use them.

If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Product Engineer, you'll help shape and scale Base360.ai across the entire short-term rental lifecycle.

You'll build customer-facing features, operational dashboards, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, and integrations that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.

Your Mission

Understand Customer Problems

Work directly with property managers and internal teams to understand their workflows, identify friction, and decide which problems are worth solving.

Build Products End-to-End

Take features from idea and prototype through frontend, backend, integrations, testing, and deployment. Own the complete experience and how it performs in production.

Create Intuitive User Experiences

Work with designers to make complex short-term rental operations easy to manage. Build interfaces that help users complete tasks quickly and confidently.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Features

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Connect the Ecosystem

Build reliable APIs and integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Solve Real Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
Dynamic pricing intelligence
Smart lock access and key management
Automated guest communication across channels
Guest check-in and upsell journeys
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Measure and Improve

Use customer feedback, product usage, and operational results to evaluate what you ship. Improve features based on adoption, time saved, fewer errors, and better user outcomes.

Build for Scale

Make sound technical decisions that balance delivery speed, maintainability, security, and reliability as more operators and properties join the platform.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

Python
FastAPI
React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe
Docker
GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

Strong experience building and shipping production software
The ability to work across frontend and backend systems
Experience with React, TypeScript, Python, FastAPI, or similar technologies
Strong understanding of APIs, databases, integrations, and cloud architecture
A product mindset and curiosity about why users need a feature
Good judgment around usability, scope, and technical trade-offs
The ability to turn an ambiguous problem into a practical, working solution
Confidence working directly with customers, designers, and founders
The ability to work independently and own outcomes
Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
A bias toward shipping, learning, and iterating

Bonus Points For Experience With

Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Product analytics and experimentation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

You've shipped features that property managers actively use
Core short-term rental workflows are automated through products you've built
Customers spend less time on manual administration and repetitive tasks
Complex workflows become easier to understand and complete
Integrations move reservations, availability, payments, and operational data reliably
AI-powered features become part of customers’ everyday operations
Customer feedback and usage data consistently inform your product decisions
Your work helps operators grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Own the Product Outcome

Help decide what to build, how it should work, and how to measure its success. Take responsibility for features from the first conversation through ongoing improvement.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across product, software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
You want a narrowly defined role with limited customer or product involvement
You need detailed specifications before you can make progress
You avoid ownership and accountability
You consider a feature finished without checking whether it solves the user’s problem

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

About Wunderdog

We're a 70-person consultancy helping development teams get better at using AI tools to build things the right way and faster. Not through Powerpoint slides, but through handson training workshops and actual work in teams at companies like Finnair, Elisa, SOK, Alma Media, Sanoma, Blueprint Genetics, RELEX, Smartly and Babbel. Our focus is the development team and nothing else. We care about making teams better more than anyone else.

Senior AI Developer

As a Senior AI Developer, you will pioneer the integration of generative AI into real-world applications, guiding customers from early experimentation to production-ready systems that deliver measurable value.

What You Will Do

Design and build AI-powered solutions end to end: from prototypes to production services and, ideally, the frontends and tools around them.
Work with modern GenAI techniques (LLMs, RAG, agents, tool-use, evaluation / guardrails) and integrate them into existing systems and workflows.
Lead technical discovery and architecture discussions with customers, turning fuzzy problems into clear, actionable roadmaps.
Coach client organisations in adopting agentic development practices, with harness engineering as one part of the toolkit
Own delivery: orchestrate agents to produce clean, testable code, design scalable cloud architectures, and make sure what we build can be operated in the real world, with the engineer accountable for every line that ships.
Act as an AI advisor: run workshops, pair with customer teams, and help them reskill and adopt AI sustainably instead of just shipping PoCs.
Contribute to our wider community: share learnings with colleagues, and when possible, speak, write or demo in public forums.

Consulting for us means shipping and helping teams get the ball rolling when they're stuck. You propose solutions, and prove with agentic harness that your solutions work. You will be working as part of our client teams and can also lead Wunderdog's entry into new clients. You build trust through your work. You speak fluent Finnish and English.

We work with these technologies and we hope most of these are familiar to you.

React, CSS Frameworks, React Native, Flutter, Contentful, Accessibility, Typescript, Express, Next.js, Java, Kotlin, Spring, Node, C#, Golang, Python SQL, REST, GraphQL, Kafka, Elastic Search, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Pulumi, AWS CDK, Event-Driven architectures, Microservices, Majestic Monoliths, OWASP TOP10, STRIDE, DevSecOps, Unit testing, Integration testing, e2e testing, CI/CD, Sentry, ELK, Splunk, LLMs, Github Co-Pilot, Claude Code, Codex, Local LLMs

At SimCorp, we build products that power investment management and financial institutions worldwide. We support some of the largest financial institutions in the world to be successful by simplifying their investments, accounting and operations.

Investment Operations is a product area within SimCorp’s Product Division, which delivers functionality enabling the operations users to be highly efficient. It also offers full STP and automation capability for the workflows and processes seamlessly across the product areas and the financial institutions workflows.

As part of our Investment Operations Product Area, you will contribute to the development of enterprise products within this product area. Collaborate closely with Product Owners, Technical Leads, and teammates during analysis, refinement, and development.

Mentor and support less experienced engineers through pair programming, code reviews, and knowledge sharing.
Drive improvements in automation, CI/CD pipelines, and development tools.
Ensure adherence to engineering best practices (XP, TDD, clean code).
Engage in Sprint Reviews/Demos and continuous process improvements

Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field.
5+ years of professional experience with C# (.NET or .NET Framework) and Angular.
Extensive experience in designing and developing enterprise applications. in.NET / C# and working knowledge of Angular.
Demonstrated expertise in automation frameworks and CI/CD
Solid understanding of manual testing techniques and QA best practices.

NICE TO HAVE

jobs.description:
Location:
Singapore

Function:
IT Infrastructure, Cloud Architecture and Engineering

Reports to:
Head of Engineering and IT

About Us

Dymon Asia Capital is a Singapore headquartered multi-strategy hedge fund managing approximately USD 5 billion in assets. Founded in Singapore and built around Asian markets, we run a range of strategies across macro, commodities, and systematic trading. We employ around 350 people across nine offices globally, with Singapore as our headquarters and primary technology hub. We are regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore and operate under the regulatory regimes of the markets in which we invest.

The IT Infrastructure function is organized across four pillars: Network, Windows, Linux, and Cloud. It is a lean six-person team of senior engineers, working in close partnership with the Cybersecurity function and with the trading and research desks it supports.

This role owns the cloud and productivity platform. That means both the architecture and the hands that build it. There is no separate engineering layer to hand designs to. You will define the landing zone, build it, migrate workloads onto it, and run it. We are not looking for a design-only architect.

The estate is Microsoft-centric. Azure runs on a hub-and-spoke topology out of Singapore, connected to our offices over ExpressRoute and VPN, and we run Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID, and Intune alongside it. There is a substantial program ahead: migrating remaining on-premises workloads to Azure, modernizing legacy applications onto platform services, and building out the data platform. Uptime and latency affect trading and research directly, so resilience and change discipline matter more here than breadth of technology. We want streamlined platforms sized for a fast-moving fund, not the complexity of a large bank.

Key Responsibilities

Own the Azure landing zone architecture, including subscription and management group design, governance guardrails, and policy baselines, right sized to the firm rather than to enterprise scale.
Design and build the Azure network fabric alongside the Network Architect, covering hub-and-spoke topology, peering, security groups, and hybrid connectivity across Azure Arc, VPN Gateway, and ExpressRoute.
Own the design and configuration of Azure Firewall, including forced tunnelling and traffic routing between DMZ and production environments.
Lead cloud migration strategy and execution, moving on-premises workloads to Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS with clear cutover and rollback plans.
Re-architect and modernize legacy applications onto Azure Web Apps and platform services, improving scalability, fault tolerance, and API-based integration.
Build and maintain the data platform architecture, integrating Azure Data Factory, Synapse Analytics, Databricks, and Microsoft Purview for data governance and lineage.
Administer Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online, including mailbox management, conditional access, and email security, alongside Intune device management and compliance policy.
Design and test disaster recovery and backup strategies, and own monitoring and alerting across Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights, ensuring telemetry is available to the security operations function.
Optimize cloud spend through autoscaling, resource right-sizing, and reservation strategy, and report on run-rate and forecast.
Implement platform security controls including Entra ID, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management, Key Vault, and encryption, aligned to MAS Technology Risk Management guidelines and NIST CSF 2.0, with cybersecurity architecture review as a required gate on new designs.

Requirements

8 or more years in cloud and infrastructure roles, including at least 3 years carrying architecture and design ownership. Experience in a regulated financial services environment is advantageous.
Currently hands-on. You should be actively building and operating cloud infrastructure today, not directing others who do.
Demonstrated track record designing and delivering enterprise cloud migrations across hybrid environments, end to end.
Expert-level Azure IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS design and operation, with Azure CLI, PowerShell, and infrastructure as code using Terraform or Bicep.
Azure networking, including virtual networks, VPN Gateway, ExpressRoute, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Traffic Manager, Azure Firewall, and security groups.
Microsoft 365 and Exchange Online administration, including conditional access, email security, and Intune device management and compliance.
Identity and platform security, including Entra ID, RBAC, Privileged Identity Management, Key Vault, and Defender for Cloud.
Application modernization, including legacy-to-platform migration, Azure Web Apps, and API-based re-architecture, alongside data services such as Azure SQL, Data Factory, Synapse, and Databricks.
DevOps and automation, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization with Docker and Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
Delivered platform builds or migrations in a lean team. Available to execute out-of-hours cutover windows, with communication skills to articulate the business value of technical work.

Preferred certifications: AZ-305 Azure Solutions Architect Expert or AZ-104 Azure Administrator Associate. AZ-500 Azure Security Engineer Associate and multi-cloud experience with AWS or Google Cloud are advantageous.

Contribute actively to the software design and end-to-end delivery of scalable enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC and .NET 10, collaborating with senior engineers and the dedicated architect to implement robust technical solutions.

Manage modern development workflows in GitLab, utilizing standardized branching strategies, merge request processes and CI/CD practices.
Work closely within a collaborative team environment, actively sharing knowledge on modern .NET development, participating in peer code reviews and contributing to a culture of continuous learning.

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the .NET ecosystem, with a strong passion for modern C# features and ASP.NET Core.
Solid expertise in software design and architecture (Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture and Modular Design), with the ability to propose and implement scalable solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Database Architecture and SQL, with experience optimizing Entity Framework Core integrated with Oracle DB (experience with other relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server is highly acceptable).

About Sedna

Sedna is at the forefront of revolutionising global trade, serving as the North Star for businesses navigating the complexities of international commerce. Our AI-powered platform is designed to make global trade more efficient, transparent, and sustainable. As we continue to mature and innovate, we are looking for exceptional talent to join our journey and contribute to our mission of transforming global trade.

You can find out more about us on our website: https://sedna.com/

About the role

This is where you come in. As an Application Support Engineer (L2), you'll be part of a support team spanning Cape Town, Athens, and colleagues across Norway and South America, giving us close to round-the-clock coverage and a genuinely global view of our customers. You'll split your time between L1 and L2 work depending on what's coming through, which keeps things varied and means no two days look quite the same.

The problems that land with you won't always have an obvious answer. You'll get into API issues, integration quirks, and the finer detail of how the platform behaves under pressure, working closely with Engineering and Product to get to the bottom of things and feed what you learn back into a better product.

Every fix you land keeps a shipowner, operator, or broker moving, and every improvement you help drive makes things a little easier for the next customer who needs it. That's the kind of impact this role carries.

Your responsibilities

Customer troubleshooting and resolution

Get stuck into technical support up to L2 level, engaging directly with customers to understand what they're experiencing and guiding them confidently to a resolution.
Dig into complex technical issues, including API-related problems, using diagnostic tools and sharp instincts to find the root cause rather than just papering over the symptoms.
Build genuine trust with customers through clear communication, technical know-how, and efficient resolution, keeping our response and resolution standards front of mind on every case.
Take part in the team's on-call rota alongside colleagues across our global support locations, helping deliver the round-the-clock coverage our customers expect (locations and timings to be confirmed).

Engineering and Product collaboration

Team up with Engineering and Product to resolve client-reported bugs and broken features, arming them with the context they need to move fast.
Turn what you're hearing from customers into insight that shapes the product, helping the wider team spot patterns and recurring issues before they become bigger problems.
Keep communication sharp and real-time across internal channels, meetings, email, bug reports, and documentation, so nothing gets lost in translation on its way to a fix.

Process and documentation

Help build and refine support processes and customer-facing materials, including FAQs and troubleshooting guides, bringing ideas for how the wider function can work better as you spot the gaps.

Technical proficiency

Comfortable working within a SaaS environment, including cloud-hosted infrastructure, APIs, and the fundamentals of performance and scalability, with enough grasp of CI/CD pipelines to understand how changes make their way to production.

What we're looking for

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
2+ years of experience in a dedicated technical support role with deep understanding of software and applications.
Experience working in or exposure to a SaaS environment, including cloud hosting, APIs, and an awareness of performance and scalability considerations.
Have supported maritime, shipping, commodities, logistics customers.
White glove customer service and communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
A learner who documents findings and is comfortable picking up new tools and systems - troubleshooting problems that do not have obvious answers.

Our Values

Finally, culture is important to us, so we also look for candidates who share our values:

Stay Ahead, Stay Agile

We don’t just adapt-we anticipate change and act with confidence.
Curiosity, data, and customer insights help us stay ahead of the curve.
We embrace challenges as opportunities and remain resilient under pressure.
By staying open to new ideas and ways of working, we lead the future.

Execute With Focus

We turn strategy into action, delivering measurable results that matter.
Every initiative counts-discipline and ownership drive business impact.
We make smart decisions with speed, balancing pace and precision.
Clear priorities keep us focused on what moves the needle.

Work Together, Win Together

JOB TITLE: AI/CLOUD PLATFORM ENGINEER

LOCATION: SCHAERBEEK, BELGIUM

LANGUAGES: ENGLISH, FRENCH OR DUTCH IS A BIG PLUS

WORK MODE: HYBRID (1 TO 2 DAYS ONSITE PER WEEK)

DURATION: ASAP - END OF 2026 (RENEWABLE)

CONTEXT AND OBJECTIVE OF THE MISSION

The contract aims to technically strengthen the AI Platform Team in the realization, industrialization and operational support of a standardized, secure, scalable and cost-efficient enterprise AI platform.
The AI Platform Engineer is responsible for the hands-on implementation of reusable platform services for generative AI, Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) and agentic AI. The contractor translates the defined architecture, standards and governance requirements into automated platform components that can be used by multiple development and platform teams.
The assignment does not include ownership over business-specific use cases or business KPIs. The focus is on generic platform capabilities, self-service, technical quality assurance and the controlled transition from proof of concept to production.

Tasks and responsibilities

AI-platform engineering

Deploy, configure, and maintain enterprise AI platform services, using AWS Bedrock as the primary platform foundation and additional cloud or on-premises integrations where required.
Integrate and manage approved foundation models, model endpoints, inference services, runtimes, and supporting frameworks.
Developing standardized APIs, SDKs, templates and reference implementations for the consumption of AI services.
Contribute to lifecycle management, version control, compatibility, technical documentation and the controlled promotion of platform components between environments.

Agentic AI in integrations

Develop and maintain reusable patterns for AI agents, tool use, planning and execution flows, and controlled interaction with enterprise services.
Deploy and secure MCP servers and other standardized tool and service integrations.
Developing agent templates and technical building blocks for identity propagation, authorization, error handling, time-outs and audit logging.
Performing technical tests on reliability, safety and predictability of agent behavior.

RAG Platform Services

Implementing generic retrieval and knowledge services for RAG applications.
Integrating vector databases, knowledge bases, embedding services and retrieval components into the AI platform.
Equipped with standardized interfaces for document and data access, respecting access rights, data classification and source reference.
Collaborate with data engineers to connect data and knowledge pipelines to the AI platform.

DevOps, Automation and self-service.

Automate provisioning, configuration, deployment, testing, and rollback through Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD.
Develop and maintain Terraform modules, GitHub Actions workflows, and reusable deployment patterns.
Equipped with paved-road workflows and self-service capabilities for team onboarding and use cases.
integrating technical policy controls and quality controls into delivery pipelines.

Security, privacy and governance

Implement technical guardrails for prompt and output control, sandboxing, network traffic, data access and tool use.
Applying secrets management, key management, least privilege, encryption and secure configuration standards.
Implementeren van policy-as-code, pre-deployment checks, audit logging en traceability.
upporting security, privacy and compliance assessments with technical evidence and remediation.

Observability, operations en FinOps

Setting up end-to-end monitoring and tracing for model calls, agent actions, toolcalls, errors, latency, policy hits and platform availability.
Integrate with Dynatrace, OpenTelemetry, Langfuse, and specialized AI observability solutions where applicable.
Supporting incident, problem and change processes, including root cause analysis and structural improvement actions.
Measuring, reporting, and optimizing inference, API, compute, networking, and storage costs by platform service or use case.

Iced technical expertise

Proven expertise in cloud and platform engineering within enterprise environments.
In-depth working knowledge of AWS and experience with Amazon Bedrock or similar generative AI platform services.
Strong programming knowledge in Python and experience in API and SDK development.
Experience with generative AI, LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, and agentic AI patterns.
Experience with MCP, tool integrations or similar open integration standards is highly desirable.
Experience with Terraform, GitHub Actions, CI/CD, GitOps, and automated quality checks.
Knowledge of containers, Kubernetes and preferably Amazon EKS.
Kennis van IAM, secrets management, policy-as-code, logging, monitoring en OpenTelemetry.
Experience with Dynatrace, Langfuse, OpenSearch, LangGraph, LangChain or similar solutions counts as an added value.

Required behavioural competencies

Takes technical ownership and works independently within established architecture and governance frameworks.
Analytical and pragmatic problem solving with attention to reliability, safety and time-to-value.
Strong collaboration skills in multidisciplinary teams.
Coaching and enablement-oriented attitude, with a focus on reusable solutions instead of customization per team.
Ability to clearly document and explain technical choices, risks and dependencies.
Good oral and written communication in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is an added value.

Wanted profile

At least five years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, platform engineering, DevOps or a similar technical domain.
Proven experience building or managing production-ready shared platform services.
Demonstrated experience with generative AI or AI/ML in a production context.
Experience with hybrid or multicloud environments and collaboration with architecture, security, and compliance.
Experience with Agile/Scrum and operational processes for incident, change and problem management.
Relevant AWS, Kubernetes, security or AI certifications count as added value.

Expected results and deliverables

Production-ready and documented AI platform components, APIs, SDKs, and deployment templates.
Automated provisioning and delivery processes with integrated quality and policy controls.
Operational monitoring, tracing, dashboards, alerts and runbooks for the platform services provided.
Reusable patterns for agents, MCP integrations, RAG, and model consumption.
Technical documentation, knowledge transfer and guidance of consuming teams.
Demonstrable improvements in reliability, security, self-service and cost control.

Cooperation and reporting

The contractor works under the functional direction of the responsible person of the platform team involved and reports on the progress, risks, dependencies and realized results to the responsible Service Delivery Manager. The contractor works closely with the relevant architecture, security, privacy, cloud, data and development functions.

jobs.title: Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform) (all genders welcome)
jobs.description:
Arbeiten bei COSMO CONSULT ist anders.

Entdecke unser Universum und lasse Dich von der positiven Energie der COSMOnaut*innen anstecken.

Gestalte die Zukunft von und mit Menschen und wachse mit uns gemeinsam.

Erlebe echte Wertschätzung in einem sicheren Umfeld voll Leidenschaft und Innovation - ganz unabhängig davon, wann und von wo aus Du arbeiten möchtest.

Werde Teil des Teams und gehöre zu einem der weltweit führenden Microsoft-Partnern für Unternehmenstransformation und Digitalisierung.

Lebe Deinen Job anders
- bewirb Dich bei uns als

Consultant (Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und Power Platform)

Das macht Dich anders.

Wir sind auf einer Wellenlänge, wenn Du:

smarte Entscheidungen triffst. Du musst nicht immer die richtigen Entscheidungen treffen, aber immer mit bestem Gewissen gegenüber unseren Kunden, Kolleg*innen und COSMO entscheiden.
den Menschen bei all Deinen Überlegungen in den Mittelpunkt stellst. Du achtest auf die Bedürfnisse aller Menschen und agierst mit Empathie und Mitgefühl.
Verantwortung übernimmst. Du bist achtsam gegenüber Dir und Deinen Mitmenschen. Auf Dich kann man sich auch über Deinen Aufgabenbereich hinaus verlassen.
uns dabei unterstützt, großartige Teams zu bilden. Alle für Dich und Du für alle - gemeinsam stärker sein. Du machst den Unterschied in Deinem Team.
immer Dein Bestes gibst. Du musst nicht der oder die Beste sein, aber aus tiefstem Respekt gegenüber Dir und Deinem Umfeld immer das Bestmögliche geben.
den Mut hast zu wachsen. Du denkst nicht in Herausforderungen, sondern in Möglichkeiten. Du liebst es, Dich weiter zu entwickeln, suchst nach neuen Ideen und bringst diese aktiv ein.
Dinge mit Leidenschaft tust. Du weißt, was Dich antreibt und begeistert, lebst Deine Leidenschaft, inspirierst dadurch Dein Umfeld, hast mehr Spaß an Deiner Arbeit und bist erfolgreicher.

Deine Persönlichkeit und Motivation ist das, was Dich ausmacht.

Daher nehmen wir uns die Zeit und schauen alle Bewerbungen individuell durch.

Dein Alltag - nur ohne Alltag

Du berätst unsere Kunden bei der Optimierung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und entwickelst gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform.
Dabei begleitest Du Projekte von der ersten Analyse über das Lösungsdesign bis zur Umsetzung und Einführung. Du verstehst die fachlichen Anforderungen unserer Kunden, übersetzt sie in tragfähige Lösungen und behältst dabei immer die End-to-End-Prozesse im Blick.

Je nach Projekt und Erfahrung übernimmst Du dabei unterschiedliche Aufgaben:

Du analysierst Geschäftsprozesse und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale.
Du führst Workshops mit Fachbereichen und weiteren Projektbeteiligten durch.
Du entwickelst strukturierte Lösungskonzepte und stimmst diese mit unseren Kunden ab.
Du setzt Lösungen selbst um oder koordinierst die Umsetzung im Team.
Du verantwortest Arbeitspakete und stellst Qualität, Standards und eine gute Dokumentation sicher.
Du bewertest Integrationen und Abhängigkeiten zu angrenzenden Systemen.
Du führst Schulungen durch und begleitest die Einführung, damit Lösungen im Arbeitsalltag nachhaltig genutzt werden.
Dabei arbeitest Du nicht nur innerhalb eines einzelnen Systems: Du denkst Prozesse, Daten und Anwendungen ganzheitlich und entwickelst Lösungen, die fachlich sinnvoll, technisch umsetzbar und langfristig skalierbar sind.

Hier bringst du Dich ein:

Du denkst Lösungen konsequent aus Nutzersicht und strukturierst sie in klare, skalierbare Use Cases.
Du übersetzt komplexe Anforderungen in tragfähige Lösungen innerhalb der Microsoft-Plattform und verbindest fachliche und technische Perspektiven.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kunden und internen Teams zusammen und bringst unterschiedliche Perspektiven zielführend zusammen.
Du entwickelst Dein Know-how kontinuierlich weiter, bleibst technologisch am Puls der Zeit und teilst Dein Wissen aktiv.
Du bringst neue Ideen ein, hinterfragst bestehende Lösungen und gestaltest Veränderungen aktiv mit.

Dein Umfeld: Teams, Tools, Zusammenarbeit

Team & Setup

Zusammenarbeit in interdisziplinären Projektteams mit Consultants, Entwickler*innen, Architekt*innen und weiteren Microsoft-Spezialist*innen.
Direkter Austausch mit Kunden, Fachbereichen und Projektbeteiligten von der Anforderungsanalyse bis zur erfolgreichen Einführung von Lösungen.
Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten kombiniert mit engem Teamzusammenhalt, Wissensaustausch und fachlicher Zusammenarbeit.

Tools & Arbeitsweise

Arbeiten im Microsoft-Ökosystem rund um Dynamics 365 CRM (Sales, Customer Service und/oder Field Service), die Power Platform mit Power Apps, Power Automate und Dataverse sowie angrenzende Microsoft- und Azure-Lösungen.
Bewertung und Einsatz neuer Technologien, insbesondere zur Automatisierung und Optimierung von Geschäftsprozessen sowie zur Nutzung von KI-Potenzialen.
Strukturierte und priorisierte Arbeitsweise, auch in parallelen Projekten und dynamischen Kundenumgebungen.
Kombination aus eigenständiger Umsetzung, fachlicher Beratung und gezielter Steuerung im Projektteam.

Deine Lernkurve bei COSMO CONSULT

Woche 1–4

Du lernst unsere Projektmethoden, Kundenstrukturen und Lösungsansätze kennen.
Du bringst Deine bisherigen Erfahrungen aktiv in laufende Kundenprojekte ein und

übernimmst frühzeitig Verantwortung für erste Themen und Arbeitspakete.

Du verstehst, wie wir Anforderungen in konkrete Lösungen übersetzen und welchen Beitrag diese zum Geschäftserfolg unserer Kunden leisten.

Nach 3 Monaten

Du verantwortest eigene Arbeitspakete und setzt diese strukturiert und lösungsorientiert um.
Du arbeitest sicher mit Kunden und Projektteams zusammen und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsdesigns und Projektentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst Lösungen weiter und passt Dich flexibel an neue Anforderungen und Technologien an.

Nach 6 Monaten

Du berätst Kunden souverän bei der Weiterentwicklung ihrer Geschäftsprozesse und bringst Deine fachliche Expertise gezielt in Lösungsentscheidungen ein.
Du entwickelst bestehende Lösungsansätze innerhalb von Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM und der Power Platform weiter und berücksichtigst dabei fachliche, technische und organisatorische Zusammenhänge.
Du bringst eigene Ideen zur Optimierung von Lösungen, Methoden und Prozessen ein und unterstützt den Wissenstransfer innerhalb des Teams.

Das bringst Du mit:

Erfahrung in der Beratung, Konzeption oder Umsetzung von Lösungen mit Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM
Praxiserfahrung mit der Microsoft Power Platform, insbesondere Power Apps, Power Automate und/oder Dataverse
Kenntnisse in mindestens einem relevanten Dynamics-365-Modul, zum Beispiel Sales, Customer Service oder Field Service
Verständnis für Geschäftsprozesse, Systemgrenzen, Integrationen und End-to-End-Zusammenhänge
Fähigkeit, komplexe Anforderungen zu analysieren und in klare, umsetzbare Lösungen zu übersetzen
Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Workshops und in der Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Projektteams
Bereitschaft, Verantwortung für fachliche Lösungen und deren erfolgreiche Umsetzung zu übernehmen
Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse auf mindestens C1-Niveau sowie gute Englischkenntnisse

Du entscheidest wann und wo, damit es für Dich, Dein Team und Deinen Arbeitstag am besten passt.

jobs.description:
Your role at Dynatrace

As a Senior Customer Success Engineer, you will be responsible for building and maintaining post-sales relationships with Dynatrace’s highest strategic customers. You will serve as a trusted advisor, ensuring the successful deployment and adoption of all Dynatrace products. Customers hold CSE's in high regard as experts and rely on you to guide them through ways of obtaining the greatest value from their Dynatrace solutions.

Responsibilities And Duties

Constantly go above and beyond to serve our customers and be a shining, standard-setting example of our Core Values
Provide advice and guidance as the subject matter expert to ensure successful ongoing usage, adoption of the product, and foster growth of the customer’s footprint
Be the customer’s advocate by knowing their goals and use cases, then suggesting process changes, product adoption, configuration, and additional features to meet their requirements
Function as a frontline technical resource for “best practice” and informal customer questions
Engage and review with customer support as a customer advocate to ensure speedy resolution of customer issues
Engage with Product management as the customer advocate on product roadmap discussions
Participate and prepare for Monthly and Quarterly Business Reviews with customers
Maintain current functional and technical knowledge of Dynatrace products and services
Help to document best practices in developing and using Dynatrace
Partners with support engineers, PM, and R&D to help customers and account teams to speed resolution. They must help, communicate, escalate and advocate on behalf of the customer.
Provides insight, advice, and ‘street credibility’ with technical teams to understand technical issues and possible workarounds.
Helps customers and account teams to understand support ticket trends/themes to be used to develop success plans, enablement advice, etc.
Has deep understanding of customers’ infrastructure, architecture, and business/regulatory requirements to speed up resolution.

What Will Help You Succeed

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent work experience
3+ years of related work experience
Experience working with large enterprise customers, including executive leadership
A track record of going above and beyond for your team and customers
Ability to manage executive relationships and discussions (VP/CxO)
Must have exceptional English and Arabic written and verbal communications skills
Exceptional organizational and teamwork skills, and the ability to act fast and responsibly
Impeccable time management skills and an ability to self-direct
Demonstrated experience being a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for Dynatrace technologies, methodologies, frameworks, and 3rd party technologies related to Dynatrace
Willingness to learn new technologies and resolve complex technical issues
Professional Level Dynatrace certification (or get certification within six months)
Strong technical understanding and experience in SaaS industry
Knowledge and experience with one or more of the following technologies related to Dynatrace: Cloud/new stack technologies such as OpenStack, OpenShift, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, Cloud Foundry, Kubernetes, SAP, etc.
Web and application server technologies such as Apache, IIS, WebSphere, WebLogic, and JBoss Server/Server-side technologies such as Java Servlets, PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Ajax
Mobile application technologies such as iOS and Android Webkit DevOps toolchain applications such as Ansible, Jenkins, Chef, Puppet, etc.
CMDB/ITSM Technologies/platforms such as ServiceNow and BMC
Demonstrable success in thinking strategically and executing tactically while providing consistent and high customer satisfaction and retention levels in a fast-paced environment

Why you will love being a Dynatracer

Dynatrace is a leader in unified observability and security.
We provide a culture of excellence with competitive compensation packages designed to recognize and reward performance.
Our employees work with the largest cloud providers, including AWS, Microsoft, and Google Cloud, and other leading partners worldwide to create strategic alliances.
You'll get to work at the forefront of innovation with Dynatrace Intelligence—the industry's first agentic operations system. Bringing together deterministic and agentic AI, it helps teams understand what's happening, why it matters, and what to do next— automatically.
Over 50% of the Fortune 100 companies are current customers of Dynatrace.

Compensation And Rewards

Due to legal reasons, we are obliged to list a salary range for this position, which is €61,000 up to €75,000 gross per year based on full-time employment (38.5 h/week). jobs.title: Software Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
This job advertisement is published on behalf of our partner Goldright.

Data is the fuel for AI and digital transformation – but only if it can be trusted.

This is where Goldright comes in: With our Enterprise Suite, we provide the essential ‘Trust Layer’ for global players and mid-sized companies. We deliver the reliable foundation that enables our customers to realize AI projects and make strategic decisions with confidence. But we don’t just enable AI for others; we breathe it ourselves.

YOUR JOB

As a Software Engineer
, you will be responsible for the continuous development and enhancement of our core product
. In this role, you will work across a broad technical spectrum, bringing in your own ideas to shape the product’s future, utilizing modern development practices—including integrating and developing AI features
directly within our solutions.

You will join a close-knit, Graz-based team of developers, collaborating tightly with Consultants, Operations and the IT department to deliver high-quality software.

Your Job’s Key Responsibilities Are

Developing high-quality software solutions and web application fundamentals using Java Core, Spring, and relational databases, with a willingness to dive into front-end topics when needed
Collaborating within a versatile team where everyone is encouraged to be a generalist, while still having room to focus on their preferred areas of expertise
Working closely with Consultants to ensure our API provides clean, flexible customization boundaries, enabling them to easily adapt the product to specific customer needs
Actively participating in our developer-driven agile workflow: enjoying 3-week sprints, dailies 3 times a week, and the freedom to self-select the tasks you want to work on
Taking part in collaborative sprint planning as well as joint sprint reviews with the entire team
Ensuring product quality through smart testing practices and conducting peer code reviews for major technical implementations
Driving innovation with AI: utilizing AI tools to accelerate your daily development and directly building advanced AI features for our product

Your Skills

Essential Skills:

3+ years of work experience in software development with Java
Completed technical studies related to software engineering or equivalent practical experience/training in software development
Solid knowledge of software development principles, database modeling (SQL), and relational databases.
Strong understanding of server-side web application fundamentals and an openness to working on both back-end and front-end topics
High personal standards regarding product quality, performance, and security
Good communication skills in English (minimum B2 level) to collaborate effectively with local and cross-functional teams
A proactive, collaborative mindset to bring your own ideas to the table, position oneself where the biggest impact can be made, and find creative solutions in a broad product landscape

Beneficial Skills

Knowledge of modern container and cluster technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure or Google Cloud Platform
Solid experience with the Spring framework
Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript or other programming languages
Experience with Hibernate/JPA
Understanding of CI/CD processes and tools
German language skills

OUR OFFER

While we’re one company, each location has unique aspects and benefits. Here’s a glimpse of what to expect:

Flexible Working Models: Early bird or night owl? Thanks to our flexible working models, you start your workday when and where it fits you best. Plus, our hybrid work option lets you choose whether you prefer working more from the office or from home.
Career Development and Onboarding: Start your journey at Goldright with a structured onboarding and mentoring phase and continue with individual training opportunities. Our People Enablement team will support you in finding the best solution for you!
Company Summit: Exchange professional and personal experiences at our annual in-house conference! One of the highlights of our Company Summit is the vibrant networking environment it cultivates.
Social Events: Join our colleagues and build new connections at our social events such as pizza evenings, sports activities, Christmas parties, or milestone celebrations.
Snacks and Wellbeing: Fuel your productivity and taste buds with our monthly meal allowance and discounts at partner restaurants.
Mobility Support: Choose eco-friendly transportation! As we take our responsibility for the environment seriously, we support your climate-friendly transportation costs.

The actual salary depends on your qualifications and experience and is significantly above the minimum salary defined by the collective agreement. What is also important to us is to pay our employees an internally comparable salary. For legal reasons, we need to disclose the minimum annual salary for full time employment as stated in the current collective IT agreement, which is € 55,356 gross/year for this position.

First Line Software works with some of the world's top businesses and organizations in industries like healthcare, data engineering, warehouse automation, retail digitalization, mobile app development, and e-commerce. Our projects are as varied as our people, and our people are as talented as they come. We prefer working as a transparent and supportive team, who shares our knowledge as well as our success.

Let's see what we can create together!
The project and your role

Our client is rebuilding its guest-facing digital estate on a modern microservices architecture moving away from a fragmented collection of out-of-the-box portals toward a purpose-built digital platform that delivers personalised, seamless guest experiences across discovery, booking, pre-stay, and in-stay touchpoints. As a Digital Product Engineer, you'll build the digital products guests and staff use every day, working on a React/Next.js front-end and a back-end of independently deployable .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices hosted on AWS.
Build and maintain guest-facing features in React and Next.js — search, the booking funnel, conversion optimisation, and promotional campaign delivery, in partnership with commercial and marketing teams
Deliver logged-in guest journeys on the guest portal, including pre-stay upsell, activity booking, and in-stay engagement
Contribute to loyalty platform features — enrolment flows, member personalisation, and loyalty mechanics
Design and build .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core microservices — REST APIs, domain logic, and integrations with core booking, CMS, and contact-center systems
Deploy and operate microservices on AWS using Lambda and ECS/Fargate, choosing the right hosting model per service
Implement event-driven communication between services using AWS SQS, SNS, and EventBridge
Design RESTful APIs to agreed standards, including OpenAPI specifications, versioning, and documentation
Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests, and ship through CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
Participate in code reviews with nearshore engineering partners and take ownership of your services in production, including incident response

Your skills

2+ years of software engineering experience spanning front-end and back-end development
Hands-on, production experience with React and Next.js — App Router, server components, SSR/SSG
Hands-on, production experience with .NET (Core/.NET 5+) and C#; .NET 8 / ASP.NET Core strongly preferred
TypeScript across the stack
Demonstrable experience building and deploying microservices on AWS (Lambda and/or ECS/Fargate)
Experience with RESTful API design in a microservices architecture
Experience working in agile sprint teams, ideally alongside nearshore or offshore engineering partners
Consumer-facing product experience — eCommerce, hospitality, travel, or retail preferred
English language proficiency for technical documentation and team communication

Nice to have:

Experience integrating LLMs or conversational AI (OpenAI API or equivalent)
WhatsApp Business API or Amazon Connect experience
Familiarity with hospitality CRS/PMS systems

Our modern stack projects are the right mix of exciting and challenging
Gain access to our diverse range of training programs, courses, and certifications
Choose your work style — this role is hybrid, with 3 days a week in the office
Enhance your language skills with our corporate English classes
Work from anywhere and explore the world with our Workation program

NUESTRO CLIENTE

Compañía tecnológica de capital privado, multinacional inglesa con fuerte presencia en Europa, especializada en servicios IT, cloud, infraestructura, ciberseguridad, workplace, managed services y transformación digital para grandes organizaciones. EL PROYECTO

En el marco de su crecimiento en España (y global), la compañía está impulsando una nueva unidad de negocio especializada en Inteligencia Artificial
, concebida como una línea estratégica de alto impacto dentro del grupo. Se trata de una apuesta corporativa con visibilidad internacional, conectada con HQ y con participación activa en el CoE global de IA de la compañía.

El rol tendrá una doble dimensión especialmente atractiva. Por un lado, será una figura clave de cara al mercado, acompañando a clientes en la identificación de casos de uso, diseño de arquitecturas, construcción de propuestas, desarrollo de PoCs/PoVs y defensa técnica de soluciones de IA ante interlocutores C-Level. PRINCIPALES FUNCIONES

Acompañar a los equipos comerciales y account managers en sesiones de discovery con clientes, identificando necesidades, pain points, casos de uso y criterios técnicos de decisión.
Diseñar arquitecturas de soluciones Data & AI basadas en plataformas cloud y tecnologías como Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Google Vertex AI, Mistral AI u otras soluciones de IA privada o soberana.
Elaborar propuestas técnicas, Statements of Work, planes de PoC/PoV, estimaciones de esfuerzo, arquitecturas de referencia y documentación de solución.

Mantenerse actualizado/a sobre nuevas herramientas, modelos, frameworks de orquestación y tendencias de mercado en el ámbito de IA generativa, agentes, RAG, MLOps/LLMOps y cloud AI.

Experiencia aproximada de 4 a 7 años, o superior, en Data & AI Solution Architecture, Technical Presales, Cloud AI Architecture, Data Platform Architecture o consultoría tecnológica especializada.

Capacidad para construir o liderar PoCs, PoVs, demos y prototipos orientados a demostrar valor de negocio.
Nivel alto de español e inglés (imprescindible)
Valorable certificación Azure AI Engineer Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert o equivalentes.

Company Description

As Hungary’s most attractive employer in 2025 (according to Randstad’s representative survey), Deutsche Telekom IT Solutions
is a subsidiary of the Deutsche Telekom Group. The company provides a wide portfolio of IT and telecommunications services with more than 5300 employees. We have hundreds of large customers, corporations in Germany and in other European countries.

DT-ITS recieved the Best in Educational Cooperation award from HIPA in 2019, acknowledged as the the Most Ethical Multinational Company in 2019. The company continuously develops its four sites in Budapest, Debrecen, Pécs and Szeged and is looking for skilled IT professionals to join its team.

Job Description

The Project: Internal Support Tools Evolution

You are joining an initiative focused on the evolution, modernization of the Internal Application Landscape. This project involves the strategic transition of well-known cloud services and legacy .NET architectures into a next-generation, AI-augmented, and cloud-native software landscape.

Our goal is not simply to "maintain" the existing system, but to proactively transform it—ensuring sovereignty, high-performance scalability, and seamless handover readiness through disciplined engineering.

Our Engineering Philosophy

We operate at the intersection of Legacy Stability and Modern Innovation. Our approach is defined by:

AI-Augmented Engineering: We utilize advanced AI development environments (such as Cursor, Windsurf, and Claude Code) and cutting-edge model families to accelerate code comprehension, refactoring, and documentation.
Disciplined SDLC Patterns: We move beyond traditional development by implementing repeatable, evidence-based SDLC patterns. Every change is backed by structured engineering evidence and rigorous automated testing.
The "Strangler Fig" Modernization: We prioritize risk-mitigated evolution, using sophisticated patterns to wrap, refactor, and eventually replace legacy components.
High-Seniority Autonomy: We operate as a lean, highly autonomous unit. We value "technical detectives" who can navigate ambiguity and perform deep reverse engineering.

Mission

To drive the technical execution of both high-impact feature development and the deep-dive modernization of our legacy .NET ecosystem. You will be a specialist who finds satisfaction in solving complex puzzles, utilizing AI-assisted tools to accelerate the modernization of our core systems.

Role Focus

This role focuses on high-complexity coding, deep reverse engineering, and AI-augmented productivity. You will work in the trenches of the legacy codebase, extracting logic and implementing modern, testable solutions using the latest AI-powered development environments.

Key Responsibilities

Complex Feature & Refactoring: Design and implement sophisticated new functionalities within the existing .NET ecosystem, ensuring seamless integration with legacy components.
Deep Reverse Engineering: Analyze and deconstruct complex, undocumented, or "spaghetti" legacy code to understand underlying business rules and technical flows.
AI-Augmented Coding: Proactively utilize AI coding assistants and advanced environments (e.g., Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, or VS Code extensions) to accelerate code comprehension, documentation, and refactoring.
Robust Testing & Stability: Write high-quality unit and integration tests to "wrap" legacy modules, providing a safety net for all refactoring efforts.
Technical Troubleshooting: Act as a high-level escalation point for complex bugs and performance bottlenecks within the legacy environment.
Internal Tooling: Utilize Microsoft PowerApps to build rapid, lightweight administrative or maintenance utilities to support the development and operations lifecycle.

Qualifications

Experience: 6+ years of professional software development experience, with deep expertise in the .NET/C# stack.
Legacy Navigation: Proven experience working with older .NET versions (e.g., .NET Framework) and managing the complexities of monolithic architectures.
AI Tooling Proficiency: Hands-on familiarity with AI coding assistants, prompt engineering, or local model experimentation.
Core Skills: Mastery of SOLID principles, design patterns, and advanced debugging/profiling techniques.
Testing Mindset: Strong commitment to TDD and automated testing (Unit/Integration) to protect the legacy core.

Additional Information

Please be informed that our remote working possibility is only available within Hungary due to European taxation regulation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Performance Engineering & Test Automation
jobs.description:
Kik vagyunk?

A Spice IT Zrt. 2021. végén indult azzal a céllal, hogy ügyfeleinknek innovációval,
megbízhatósággal és szakértelemmel fűszerezett tech-megoldásokat szállítsunk.
Ma már 90+ szakértőből álló csapatunk dolgozik azon, hogy minden projektünk ne csak
működjön, hanem értéket teremtsen – magas színvonalon, hatékonyan, lelkesedéssel és egy
csipet fűszerrel.
Otthon vagyunk a digitális csatornák fejlesztésében, frontend és backend rendszerek építésében, DevOps-ban, microservice-alapú és hagyományos IT-megoldásokban – és nem riadunk meg a komplex kihívásoktól sem.
Fejlesztők, tesztelők, architektek, delivery managerek és folyamat-szakértők alkotják a
csapatunkat, ahol a profi munka mellett mindig jut hely a humornak és kreativitásnak is.
Ha szereted, hogy a munkád pörög, és nem félsz új technológiákhoz nyúlni – nálunk otthon leszel.

Miről is szól ez a pozíció?

Olyan Software Engineert
keresünk, akit érdekel, mi történik a rendszer mélyén, amikor a válaszidő 200 ms-ról hirtelen 2 másodpercre nő – és nem áll meg addig, amíg meg nem találja, hogy a probléma a kódban, az adatbázisban, a hálózaton vagy az architektúrában van.
Kifejezetten olyan csapattagot keresünk, aki valódi "tech detective"
gondolkodásmóddal rendelkezik: nem elégszik meg a felszíni tünetekkel, hanem szeret leásni a kód-, adatbázis- és architektúra-szinteken, hogy feltárja a teljesítménybeli akadályok és komplex hibák valódi gyökerét (root cause analysis). Tehát: nem tesztesetek végrehajtására keresünk kollégát, hanem arra, hogy mérnöki eszközökkel segítsen gyorsabbá, stabilabbá és skálázhatóbbá tenni komplex enterprise rendszereket.

Milyen problémákon dolgozhatsz?

Miért lassul le egy API csak nagy concurrency mellett?
A JVM, az adatbázis, a hálózat vagy egy downstream service a bottleneck?
Hogyan bizonyítod méréssel, hogy egy architekturális változtatás valóban javított a teljesítményen?
Hogyan építesz performance regression tesztet a CI/CD pipeline-ba?
Hogyan reprodukálsz egy csak production-like terhelés mellett jelentkező hibát?

Miért izgalmas ez a lehetőség?

Szabadság és formálás:
Nem egy kész tesztcsomagot kell üzemeltetned - engineering szemlélettel dolgozhatsz azon, hogyan mérjük, elemezzük és javítjuk komplex banki rendszerek teljesítményét.
Valós technikai mélység:
Kód, JVM/runtime, API-k, adatbázisok, infrastruktúra, observability és architektúra – a problémák ritkán állnak meg egyetlen technológiai rétegen.
Mérhető eredmény:
Az elkészült tesztesetek száma helyett a lényeg az, hogy megtaláljuk és megszüntessük a rendszer valódi szűk keresztmetszeteit.
Engineering impact:
A megállapításaid közvetlenül hathatnak fejlesztési és architekturális döntésekre.

Mik a főbb feladatok?

Gyökérok-elemzés (Root Cause Analysis): Kód, adatbázisok, hálózat és logok elemzése a rejtett teljesítményproblémák feltárására.
Teljesítmény-optimalizálás: Bottleneckek, memóriaszivárgások és skálázhatósági kockázatok azonosítása és elemzése banki környezetben.
Kódalapú tesztautomatizálás és mérés: Automatizált terheléses és integrációs mérések építése és továbbfejlesztése.
Performance testing: Terheléses, stressz- és endurance tesztek tervezése és futtatása (pl. k6, JMeter, Gatling).
CI/CD & Shift-Left szemlélet: Automatizált és performancia tesztek beépítése a CI/CD pipeline-okba.
Architecture & Code Review: Együttműködés a fejlesztői, architekt és DevOps csapatokkal kódszintű javítások és architekturális döntések támogatásában.
Monitoring & Observability: Rendszerstatisztikák és metrikák elemzése APM és observability eszközökön keresztül (pl. Grafana, Kibana, Dynatrace).

Mik az alapvető elvárások?

Magabiztos szoftverfejlesztési alapok és gyakorlati fejlesztői tapasztalat
legalább egy modern programozási nyelven
(pl. Java, Node.js/TypeScript, Python, C# vagy Go)
"Tech detective" és kíváncsi szemléletmód:
Erős belső indíttatás és analitikus képesség a problémák gyökeréig való leásásra
Nyitottság és affinitás a szoftverminőség, a tesztautomatizálás és a teljesítmény-finomhangolás (performance tuning) iránt
Tapasztalat API-k, microservice architektúrák és adatbázisok (SQL/NoSQL) működésében és vizsgálatában
Tiszta kód elvek (Clean Code), verziókövető rendszerek (Git) és rendszerszintű technikai szemlélet ismerete.
Nyelvtudás: Minimum középfokú angol nyelvtudás
Jelenlét:
Heti 2 nap onsite jelenlét vállalása (Budapest, XIII. kerület)

Nem várjuk el, hogy minden felsorolt technológiában szakértő legyél – számunkra a fejlesztői alapok, a rendszerszintű gondolkodás és a problémamegoldó attitűd fontosabb, mint egy konkrét toolset.

Előny, ha rendelkezel

Banki vagy egyéb erősen szabályozott enterprise környezetben szerzett tapasztalattal
Ismerettel legalább egy elterjedt automatizálási vagy performancia-tesztelő keretrendszer terén (pl. k6, JMeter, Cypress, Playwright, REST Assured).
