jobs.title: Senior Server Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

General Info

This position is on-site in Budapest and requires EU residency or an exiting EU work visa.

We are developing a breakthrough imaging and 3D technology platform currently under provisional patent. The Senior Backend Systems Engineer builds and maintains the production server software that delivers this platform to end users — the high-throughput API backend, the ML inference gateway that serves our models, and the internal control-plane services that hold the whole system together. Our technology is developed and trained on our on-premises GPU cluster; this role is responsible for the software that takes those trained models and our product experiences and serves them reliably to hundreds of thousands of concurrent users.
This is, first and foremost, a software engineering role. The person in this position writes solid production C++ on the hot paths where throughput, tail latency, and memory behavior are first-class product attributes; writes the Python services where development velocity, clarity, and integration breadth matter most; writes the bash and shell tooling that automates build, deployment, and operational tasks; and designs the concurrency, I/O, and state-management strategies that let live user connections survive instance failure, rolling deployment, and capacity rebalance without the end user noticing. The role exists because shipping an imaging and ML platform at scale requires server software written deliberately, not assembled from configuration.
This is a hands-on, high-ownership senior role focused on writing efficient, scalable server software. DevOps experience — cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, and observability — is a strong plus and part of how the person in this role ships and operates their own code, but the primary focus is the software itself.
Tasks

Server Software & Performance Engineering

Design, write, and maintain the production server software that runs the Company’s platform: the API backend that serves the website, mobile, and e-commerce traffic; the ML inference gateway that fronts our GPU-backed model serving; and the internal control-plane services that coordinate them.
Write the performance-critical code paths in modern C++ — the request hot paths where latency budgets are measured in milliseconds, the dispatch and batching logic where efficiency depends on careful queueing, and the data paths where allocation behaviour and memory layout determine whether the system meets its throughput targets.
Write the Python services that surround and complement the C++ core — control-plane logic, integration glue, request orchestration, and the parts of the stack where development velocity and clarity matter more than raw performance.
Write the bash and shell tooling that automates build, deployment, data movement, and routine operational tasks, and keep that tooling reliable and maintainable.
Design and implement graceful connection and session migration so that live user connections survive instance failure, rolling deployment, and capacity rebalance — handed off to healthy instances without the end user perceiving an interruption.
Maximize throughput and minimize tail latency at the hot paths through deliberate, justified choices in concurrency model, non-blocking I/O strategy, memory and allocation behaviour, serialization format, and batching. Treat response time as a product attribute, not an operations metric.
Profile, diagnose, and optimize performance end-to-end — from CPU and GPU utilization through network and storage paths — and fix root causes in the server code rather than working around them in infrastructure.

ML Inference Serving

Contribute to the inference gateway as a software engineering problem: request batching, GPU memory management, model versioning, request-level latency budgets, and graceful degradation under overload.
Support the training-to-serving handoff in partnership with the ML team: model packaging and artifact format, staged rollouts and version pinning, and the operational contract between the on-premises training cluster and the cloud serving tier.
Build inference-time observability — request-level traces and per-model latency telemetry — so model performance is debuggable in production and inference regressions can be investigated quickly.

Platform & Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work within the service boundaries, deployment patterns, data and caching layers, and performance constraints of the platform, and contribute to their evolution for the website, e-commerce, and mobile API backend.
Partner closely with the Mobile Software Engineer on the mobile API backend — authentication, data synchronization, media upload and download, offline-capable request patterns, and the latency and reliability contract that the mobile client depends on.
Integrate with third-party systems: e-commerce engine, product-supply and fulfilment systems, payment processors, and communication services.
Contribute to the data architecture: operational databases, caches, object storage, analytics pipelines, and the movement of data between on-premises and cloud environments.

Infrastructure & Operations

Deploy, operate, and reason about the systems you write. You are responsible for your code in production, including its observability, its failure modes, and its cost. A senior backend engineer who can run their own code in production is exactly what this role is asking for.
Work fluently with cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) — compute, networking, storage, identity, and the operational surface — to deploy your services and the platform around them. Use infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines as engineering tools.
Establish the observability practices for your code: meaningful metrics, structured logs, distributed traces, and dashboards that make production behaviour intelligible. Define service-level objectives for the services you own.
Participate in the on-call rotation for the systems you build, and help drive incident response when something you own breaks in production. Blameless postmortems and follow-through on remediation are part of the role.

Collaboration & Craft

Contribute to architecture and design discussions for backend systems and ML serving, review proposals from teammates, and push back constructively to raise the bar for production quality.
Mentor less-experienced engineers through code review, design review, and pair-programming on hard problems. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not an engineering management role.
Maintain architectural documentation, design records, and operational runbooks as living, accurate artifacts — not write-once shelf-ware.

Requirements

Education & Experience

Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical field.
At least five years of relevant backend systems, distributed-systems, or platform-software engineering experience.
Demonstrated track record of having personally written significant portions of at least one high-throughput production server system — not having only operated one that someone else wrote. Code samples, open-source contributions, or detailed system descriptions in interview will be expected.
Hands-on production experience deploying and operating your own services, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability.

Skills & Competencies

Solid proficiency in modern C++ (C++17 or later) for production server software — concurrency primitives, non-blocking I/O, memory and allocation behaviour, and the discipline to write C++ that is fast and correct under sustained production load.
Strong proficiency in Python for service implementation, control-plane logic, and integration tooling. The ability to choose deliberately between C++ and Python for a given component, and to make the two interoperate cleanly, is part of the job.
Comfortable and effective in bash / shell scripting for automation, deployment, and day-to-day operational work in a Linux environment.
Solid understanding of high-throughput, low-tail-latency server design: concurrency models, event-loop and threaded architectures, connection and session state management, backpressure, graceful degradation, and transparent failover across instances.
Strong DevOps experience is a significant plus: cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred; GCP or Azure acceptable), infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or equivalent), container orchestration (Kubernetes), and CI/CD pipelines used confidently as everyday engineering tools.
Experience with GPU-based ML inference serving — request batching, GPU memory management, model versioning, and the latency-versus-throughput tradeoffs specific to inference workloads — is a strong plus. Familiarity with serving frameworks (Triton, TorchServe, custom) is welcome, but the ability to reason about inference serving from first principles matters more than experience with any particular framework.
Solid understanding of modern observability practice — metrics, structured logs, distributed traces, and the discipline of designing for debuggability rather than retrofitting it.
Additional fluency in Go or Rust is a plus, particularly for systems-software work where the C++/Python split is not the right answer.
Ability to handle confidential and pre-patent technical material with discretion, and to follow the Company’s IP and data-handling policies rigorously.
High degree of curiosity, craftsmanship, and resilience; calm and methodical under production pressure.

Additional Preferred Experience

Experience designing or shipping inference serving infrastructure for computer vision, hyperspectral, or other high-data-volume model classes — where bandwidth, batching, and GPU memory layout dominate the engineering.
Experience with hybrid architectures spanning on-premises GPU clusters and cloud serving — model export, artifact management, and the training-to-serving handoff.
Open-source contributions to backend systems, distributed-systems, or ML serving infrastructure.
Experience with high-volume transactional backends, payment integration, or multi-region resilience engineering.

Candidates must be eligible to work in Hungary, with fluent English knowledge, both written and oral.
Compensation

The base salary range for this position is HUF 2,000,000 – HUF 2,500,000 gross per month, paid in twelve monthly installments. The range reflects a full-time, senior-level engagement and is calibrated to the Hungarian market for senior backend systems engineering with hands-on production experience writing high-throughput server software. This is negotiable for exceptional candidates.
The offered starting salary within this range will be determined on the basis of objective, gender-neutral criteria, including the candidate’s demonstrated depth of production C++ on high-throughput server systems, proficiency across Python and bash for service and operational work, breadth of hands-on DevOps and production-operations experience, and track record of shipping and running efficient, scalable server software. Advanced domain knowledge and meaningful contributions in adjacent areas (for example, GPU-based ML inference serving, computer vision or hyperspectral inference, high-volume e-commerce backends, or open-source systems software) are factors that may justify positioning toward the upper end of the range.
In addition to base salary, the total compensation package includes a discretionary performance bonus and statutory and customary benefits as applicable under Hungarian law. Details of the bonus component will be discussed with shortlisted candidates.
This salary range is disclosed in accordance with the pay transparency obligations arising from Directive (EU) 2023/970 and its transposition into Hungarian law. Candidates will not be asked about their prior or current compensation at any stage of the recruitment process.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer
who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

If you're excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Your Mission

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Systems

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Design API-First Architecture

Create robust APIs that connect internal services, booking channels, third-party providers, and customer systems.

Integrate the Ecosystem

Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other strategic partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Scale Infrastructure

Deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure designed for reliability, performance, and global growth across multiple property management businesses.

Solve Complex Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
Dynamic pricing intelligence
Smart lock access and key management
Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Move Fast and Own Delivery

Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Bring senior engineering judgment to technical decisions, code reviews, and the reliability of the systems you build.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

Python
FastAPI
React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe
Docker
GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

Strong experience building and owning production-grade software systems
Experience with FastAPI, Python, React, or similar frameworks
Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
Experience designing scalable backend systems and reliable data models
The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions
Strong problem-solving skills and a product mindset
Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
A bias toward action, shipping, and learning from real users
The ability to balance delivery speed with maintainability and reliability

Bonus Points For Experience With

Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

Core short-term rental workflows are automated through systems you've built
Property managers spend less time on manual administration
Reservations, availability, payments, and operational data move reliably between systems
New integrations are deployed and maintained reliably
AI-powered workflows become part of customers’ everyday operations
The platform supports more operators and properties while maintaining reliability and performance
Base360.ai helps customers grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Extreme Ownership

Have the freedom and responsibility to make technical decisions and deliver systems that matter.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
You prefer a narrowly defined role with limited product involvement
You need detailed instructions for every task
You avoid ownership and accountability
You're comfortable shipping work without taking responsibility for its quality

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

new_jobs.title: Trainee Automation Developer - Regio Oss
new_jobs.description:
Trainee Automation Developer & Consultant – Regio Oss

Heb jij onlangs een hbo- of wo-opleiding afgerond in bijvoorbeeld Informatica, AI, Data Science of een vergelijkbare richting? Of heb je ervaring met programmeren in bijvoorbeeld Python en ben je klaar voor jouw eerste stap als developer? En wil je je kennis verder verdiepen in de wereld van RPA en Hyperautomation? Als je de ambitie hebt om jezelf te ontplooien tot een expert die complexe problemen tackelt en strategisch advies geeft, dan is dit je kans! Lees verder en ontdek de mogelijkheden als Trainee Automation Developer bij The Public Network!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Trainee Automation Developer bij The Public Network krijg jij de kans op kennis en ervaring op te doen en te leren waar jouw passie ligt! Dit doe je niet alleen maar samen met onze experts en collega’s!
Vanaf dag één draai je mee in uitdagende projecten binnen de publieke sector. Je werkt samen met ervaren collega’s, leert iedere dag bij en ontdekt waar jouw talenten liggen.

Je gaat onder andere:
Bedrijfsprocessen analyseren en onderzoeken waar automatisering de meeste waarde toevoegt;
Software robots ontwikkelen met UiPath en andere Automation-technologieën;
Meewerken aan AI- en Hyperautomation-oplossingen;
Testen, implementeren en optimaliseren van automatiseringen;
Samenwerken met gebruikers, developers en consultants om de beste oplossingen te realiseren.

Wat ga je leren?

Onze trajecten bestaan uit drie leerlijnen waarin jij alle tools, learnings, informatie en tips meekrijgt om aan de slag te kunnen bij jouw opdrachtgever!

Jouw ontwikkeling

Bij The Public Network geloven we dat je het meeste leert door te doen. Daarom combineer je vanaf dag één uitdagende opdrachten bij verschillende overheidsorganisaties met een uitgebreid ontwikkelprogramma. Je werkt samen met ervaren Automation Consultants die jou begeleiden in de praktijk, krijgt persoonlijke coaching van onze Talentmanager en neemt deel aan intervisiedagen, kennissessies en leuke events. Zo ontwikkel je jezelf niet alleen technisch, maar ook als professional.

Je ontwikkelt jezelf op drie gebieden:

Vakinhoudelijke leerlijn

Je maakt je de kernexpertises van UiPath en RPA eigen, samen met methoden zoals Scrum en LEAN. Ook krijg je training in systeemintegratie en verschillende Automation-technologieën, zodat je stap voor stap uitgroeit tot een volwaardig Automation Consultant.

Professionele leerlijn

Naast techniek ontwikkel je de vaardigheden die je als consultant nodig hebt. Denk aan adviseren, klantgerichte communicatie, samenwerken en verandermanagement. Je kiest zelf de onderwerpen die het beste aansluiten bij jouw ambities, zodat jij kunt groeien in de richting die bij jou past.

Persoonlijk Leiderschapstraject

Ook jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling krijgt volop aandacht. Gedurende de eerste anderhalf jaar word je begeleid door een persoonlijke coach en werk je tijdens intervisies en praktijkgerichte opdrachten aan jouw leiderschap, communicatie en professionele groei. Zo ontdek je waar jouw kwaliteiten liggen en leg je een stevige basis voor de rest van je carrière.

The Public Network

Na het succesvol afronden van je traineeship, dat ongeveer 1,5 jaar duurt, stroom je door naar een vaste functie bij een lokale overheidsinstelling in de regio Oss. In deze rol ga je zelfstandig aan de slag met Automation-projecten en word je onderdeel van een team dat zich bezighoudt met Hyperautomation. Je blijft je vaardigheden verfijnen en specialiseert je verder in specifieke onderdelen van RPA en AI, zoals procesautomatisering en systeemintegratie.

Daarnaast biedt deze functie volop mogelijkheden om je verder te ontwikkelen. In overleg met de opdrachtgever kun je jouw ambities verder realiseren, bijvoorbeeld door je te specialiseren in Hyperautomation of andere geavanceerde technologieën. Zo kun je jouw carrière verder vormgeven en je expertise uitbreiden in de richting die het beste aansluit bij jouw interesses en doelen.

Hoe kom je in aanmerking voor de rol?

We kijken niet alleen naar jouw diploma of kennis, maar juist naar jouw motivatie. Wie jij bent als persoon en waar jouw interesses liggen is voor ons belangrijk. Voldoe je niet helemaal? Wij zijn altijd in voor een kennismaking!
Je bent nieuwsgierig, leergierig en vindt het leuk om technische vraagstukken op te lossen. Je hoeft nog geen ervaren Automation Developer te zijn. Wij vinden jouw motivatie en ontwikkelpotentieel minstens zo belangrijk.

Daarnaast:
Heb je een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in Informatica, AI, Data Science of Software Engineering;
Heb je affiniteit met programmeren, bijvoorbeeld in Python, Java of C#;
Vind je het leuk om samen te werken en nieuwe dingen te leren;
Beheers je de Nederlandse taal goed.

Maar wat krijg jij er nou voor terug?

Bij ons krijg je meer dan alleen een baan. We bieden de kans om jezelf te (her)ontwikkelen en om nieuwe vaardigheden te leren van professionals. Ben jij er klaar voor?
Naast een uitdagende baan krijg je alle ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.

Je kunt rekenen op:
Een startsalaris van €3000,- bruto o.b.v. 36 uur;
25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantiegeld;
Persoonlijke begeleiding door ervaren Automation Consultants;
Coaching door onze Talentmanager;
Intervisiedagen met andere young professionals;
Toffe events, kennissessies en een sterk netwerk;

Klaar voor jouw eerste stap?

Wil jij jouw carrière starten in Automation, veel praktijkervaring opdoen én jezelf ontwikkelen binnen een betrokken netwerk van professionals? Solliciteer dan nu!

Job Title:
Application Operations Engineer - Tech CSC - Counter Terrorism Policing HQ
Salary:

Location:
CSC, West Midlands

Job Summary

As an Application Operations Engineer, you'll support business-critical systems that are vital to our work in an ITIL-aligned environment. It's an IT role like no other, which comes with excellent training and the chance to build your skills. The Customer Service Centre (CSC) provide IT support to the Counter Terrorism Policing network. With the growing threat to National Security, we need to add to our dedicated teams. It's your chance to play your part in supporting UK policing.
This role is aligned to the Application Operations Engineer
role set out within the Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework (DDAT).
Thanks to fast-evolving technology, new applications are being developed for policing all the time. Your task will be to help support this growing area by tackling applications-related issues. Day-to-Day, you'll assist the Senior Application Operations Engineers and Data Engineers in maintaining the Applications portfolio to ensure we have an accurate record of supported applications. You'll also be an escalation point for all applications-related incidents, managing them through to resolution. Whenever new or improved applications roll out, your role will be key in making sure that live support is seamless.
We want you to take the initiative when it comes to good working practices and processes. So you'll need experience of applications management and ideally, knowledge of ITIL-environments. With this expertise, you'll feel confident taking responsibility for outstanding faults, liaising with users and the other technical teams.
While an understanding of Microsoft development tools is essential (IIS, .NET, MS-SQL, Visual Studio), you should be just as adept with people – and be able to explain technical issues simply and form good working relationships. If you can combine customer service experience with strong IT literacy, we can offer you an exciting role in a supportive team. The applications in our portfolio are mostly bespoke, but we'll make sure you get first-class training and an excellent work/life balance.
Join us, and you’ll be part of a team of engineers covering core working hours weekdays from the CSC operations centre and on call (roughly 1 week in 8). The role is office-based with occasional opportunities to work from home.
Key Tasks

The post holder will be required to do the following:
Working within a service team monitoring components such as web servers, applications servers, log files, disk space and MS-SQL databases.
A point of escalation for all Application related issues within the Applications Team
Working as part of a second line support function following incident management through to incident resolution. Natural problem solving with ability to apply previous experience to new problems working towards route cause analysis.
Working with third party suppliers, stakeholders and departmental ICT teams to assist in delivering patch/release of applications while coordinating vendor support.
Maintaining middleware such as; IIS, MS-SQL Server, Active Directory, ASP and. NET, including troubleshooting, performance tuning, basic querying and resolving bottlenecks.
Daily support of COTS and WEB based software applications with an emphasis on the ability to problem solve.
Strong customer focus – understanding the needs of the internal and external customer and keeping them in mind when taking actions or making decisions.

Vetting

This post requires access to the most sensitive intelligence material on a daily basis. Applicants must hold or be prepared to undergo National Security Vetting (NSV) Developed Vetting (DV) level before taking up the post.
Please note the successful candidate will be part of a recruitment pipeline for a period of up to 12 months.
Confidentiality Agreement

Applicants should also be aware of the need to sign a confidentiality agreement on taking up the post.
Our Colleague Commitments

Counter Terrorism Policing (CTP) continues to prioritize an inclusive and supportive working environment and culture, where all of our people feel a strong sense of belonging and are empowered to reach their full potential. CTP keeps the nation and everyone in it safe from all manner of threats and as those threats evolve, so do we - that’s why Inclusion, Diversity and Equality (IDE) is the key to supporting our greatest asset, our people.
Our people protect our national security across the UK. In order to continue to deliver against our organizational priorities, we collectively seek to ensure that all colleagues feel respected, supported and valued to fully participate in the delivery of our mission – “working to keep people safe from Terrorism”.
IDE is at the heart of our approach to make the composition of Counter Terrorism Policing more representative of the communities we serve. As Counter Terrorism is rooted in Local Policing, to tackle today’s complex policing challenges, applications from across all backgrounds, cultures and experiences are therefore essential and encouraged. The CTP Network is committed to ensuring that candidates identifying as disabled are able to realize their fullest career aspirations and, as such, will endeavor to accommodate any reasonable adjustments that you may require during the recruitment process. CTP also welcomes applications from candidates seeking flexible working arrangements, . All flexible working arrangements should be discussed and agreed with the hiring manager.
This role does not attract Shift Disturbance Allowance. If you are currently in a shift-working role, SDA should cease upon appointment to this job.
How to apply

To begin your career at the Met, please click the "apply button “. The application process requires a comprehensive CV, a Personal Statement, and an online application form. In your Personal Statement, you should explain your interest in the position and illustrate how your skills and experiences make you a suitable candidate. Please note that you should not submit two copies of your CV, and ensure that your documents are saved in either PDF or Word format, clearly labelled as CV and Personal Statement.
Completed applications must be submitted by 23:55 on 5th October 2026.
Once received, your application will be reviewed against eligibility criteria, following this, your application will be reviewed by the hiring manager.
Following application review, successful candidates will be invited to interview.
www.metpolicecareers.co.uk
Essential For The Role

Key Skills

The post holder must have:
Understanding of ITIL process, incident management, change management and problem management including working to strict SLAs.
Ability to understand business logic, technical tools and be an analytic thinker.
An understanding of application backup, restores and the Application Disaster Recovery (DR) process.

Experience

Previous experience of Incident and Service Request resolution using Service Management Tools.
An appreciation of Application languages and technologies including SQL, HTML, .Net, C# and IIS hosting.
Experience in utilising appropriate ITIL based Incident, Problem and Change Management processes and procedures to support and maintain applications.

Desirables

Broad understanding of Application languages and technologies including SQL, HTML, .net, C# and IIS hosting.
Previous experience of working in a 2nd Line Application Support role.
ITIL v3/4 – Foundation.

Additional Information

The Met is committed to being an equitable (fair and impartial) and inclusive employer for disabled people, striving to have a diverse and representative workforce at all levels. We particularly welcome applications from people with disabilities and long-term conditions, ethnic minority groups and women.

As a Disability Confident Leader, the Met has committed to making disability equality part of our everyday practice. We ensure that people with disabilities and those with long term conditions have the opportunities to fulfil their potential and realise their aspirations.

new_jobs.title: Senior .NET Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

Matter Administration helps customers grow and scale the eDiscovery practices and businesses they run on Relativity. The team delivers solutions that improve administrator productivity, simplify configuration, and streamline system preparation for matter review.

From matter setup and workspace configuration to data archiving, restore, cost management, and billing solutions, Matter Administration provides the tools and services Relativity Administrators use to manage their environments effectively.

This team is building a greenfield product and owns the full solution lifecycle, from implementation in .NET to deployment through GitHub Actions and monitoring with New Relic. Team members contribute to architecture, influence engineering best practices, and help shape modern, scalable cloud solutions.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, develop, test, deploy, and support RelativityOne cloud solutions built on Azure using .NET and C#. You will work as part of a Scrum team, collaborating closely with engineering peers and business stakeholders to deliver products, features, and services that evolve the RelativityOne platform.

You will contribute technical expertise across the software development lifecycle, mentor less experienced engineers, and support the team’s technical leadership while helping drive engineering excellence and continuous improvement.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Contribute to a Scrum team throughout all phases of the software lifecycle, including conception, design, development, testing, deployment, and operations.
Architect and design performant, scalable, and secure software solutions with a strong focus on quality.
Apply object-oriented analysis, design, and programming principles using C#, TypeScript, and JavaScript, including SOLID principles and design patterns.
Provide technical guidance to help deliver high-quality, secure, and scalable software operating on large volumes of data.
Participate in code reviews and promote engineering best practices.
Develop and execute comprehensive unit and integration testing strategies, including static analysis.
Improve software development processes by identifying and driving meaningful changes.
Identify, document, automate, and engineer solutions for repetitive operational tasks.
Contribute to and mature automated CI/CD deployment and upgrade workflows.
Use monitoring and observability tools to proactively identify and resolve issues.
Improve software quality, completeness, and knowledge sharing across the team.
Troubleshoot production issues, resolve defects, and respond to customer-specific problems.
Coach and mentor team members through technical guidance and education.
Participate in an on-call rotation as a second line of support after gaining sufficient domain experience.
Contribute to a culture of continuous learning, growth, and collaboration.

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of experience developing commercial software systems and applications using C#.
Experience building cloud-scalable solutions using cloud-native patterns, preferably on Microsoft Azure.
Experience working with scalable database technologies.
Experience building a cloud-focused DevOps mindset, including CI/CD processes and tools such as GitHub Actions, Harness, and LaunchDarkly, along with mature observability practices.
Ability to design and implement mature deployment and release solutions.
Strong understanding of software engineering best practices, including unit testing, code reviews, design documentation, debugging, and troubleshooting.
Hands-on experience incorporating AI tools into day-to-day engineering workflows, including:
AI-assisted code generation, refactoring, and review.
Using AI for technical design, solution exploration, and documentation.
Leveraging AI to plan and structure development and release activities.
Critically evaluating AI-generated outputs and taking ownership of final technical decisions.

Experience working in Agile software teams, including mentoring, feature leadership, and cross-functional collaboration.
Fluency in English.

Preferred

Experience with container orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code and configuration management solutions such as Pulumi.
Experience with observability platforms and monitoring solutions such as New Relic and Grafana.
Experience building web applications using JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Angular, React, or Vue.
Experience developing applications with .NET Core.

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

new_jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager (m/f/n) – Payments & Checkout
new_jobs.description:
Company Description

InPost Group
(Euronext: INPST) is Europe's leading out-of-home e-commerce delivery platform, operating over 50,000 automated parcel machines (APMs) and PUDO points across Poland, the UK, France, Italy, and Benelux
- processing tens of millions of transactions annually. Beyond logistics, InPost is building a full e-commerce services layer: InPost Pay is our integrated checkout and payments product embedded directly into the merchant journey
, with ambitions that extend into digital wallets, embedded finance, and AI-assisted commerce. This is fintech at logistics scale - and we are just getting started.

Job Description

As you probably know, a lot is happening at InPost. We build products and services that support millions of users and transactions every day. One of the key areas within our ecosystem is InPost Pay, where we develop solutions focused on digital payments, checkout experiences, and sales enablement.

We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager who will take ownership of a growing engineering organization within the Pay domain
. This is an opportunity for a leader who can scale teams, develop engineering leaders, drive technical excellence, and remain a credible partner in architectural and technology discussions.

What will you be responsible for?

Driving the growth and scalability of technology teams supporting payment, checkout, and sales-related products.
Leading an engineering organization of approximately 24–25 engineers across 3 teams:
two teams led through Engineering Managers,
one team managed directly.

Developing Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, and senior engineering talent while building a strong leadership pipeline.
Establishing and maintaining technical, architectural, and delivery standards across the entire domain.
Shaping technology strategy in close collaboration with Product, Business, and Engineering stakeholders.
Managing dependencies across teams and ensuring high-quality delivery at scale.
Identifying and removing organizational and technical bottlenecks that impact product development and business outcomes.
Defining and driving the domain's AI adoption strategy, identifying opportunities where AI can improve engineering productivity, software quality, and operational efficiency.
Promoting responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation across engineering teams while measuring business and engineering impact.
Leading the organization through data-driven decision-making by defining, monitoring, and improving domain-level KPIs, OKRs, SLAs, and engineering performance metrics.
Using engineering insights and metrics to continuously improve delivery effectiveness, platform reliability, team productivity, and customer outcomes.
Representing the engineering organization in strategic initiatives and cross-functional leadership discussions.

Qualifications

An ideal profile includes:

10+ years of experience in software engineering and technology leadership.
Experience managing Engineering Managers and multi-team engineering organizations.
Strong technical foundation gained as a Software Engineer.
Hands-on experience with Java and Spring Boot.
Excellent understanding of distributed systems, microservices, event-driven architectures, and modern backend engineering practices.
Experience working with cloud environments (Google Cloud is a strong advantage).
Experience defining technical standards, SDLC processes, governance models, and engineering operating frameworks.
Ability to translate engineering strategy into measurable business outcomes and effectively communicate with senior stakeholders.

Must have:

Hands-on technical background in the Java ecosystem (Spring Boot) or equivalent enterprise microservices stack (e.g., .NET/C#); sufficient depth to be a credible technical partner in architecture reviews and engineering decisions.
Experience within a production environment.
Experience operating in large-scale product organizations.
Proven success in building and scaling engineering organizations through leaders.
Experience implementing or scaling AI-enabled engineering practices and tools.
Strong understanding of engineering metrics, KPIs, OKRs, and organizational performance management.
Ability to use data and measurable outcomes to drive technology and organizational decisions.

Nice to have:

Experience in fintech, digital payments, checkout platforms, or embedded finance products.
Experience working in organizations building payment processing, commerce, digital wallet, or transaction-heavy platforms.
Background in successful technology scale-ups that have grown both products and engineering organizations rapidly.
Experience in regulated crypto fintech - crypto exchanges, digital asset custodians, or blockchain-based payment infrastructure operating under financial supervision (e.g., MiCA, FCA, or equivalent licensing frameworks).
Demonstrated impact of AI adoption on engineering velocity, developer experience, or software quality.
Experience building management dashboards and using data analytics to drive strategic decisions.

Additional Information

Why Join InPost?

Opportunity to work in a diverse, international, and cross-functional environment, along with leading experts.
You work and learn from a senior leader and their leadership bench, extending your experience and exposure in the e-commerce and logistics industry.
 InPost is a growing company that offers an increasing number of opportunities in several locations in Europe.
Fulfilling careers with a range of benefits, training opportunities for self-development.
You will feel a part of the InPost community that makes an impact on sustainability, convenient deliveries, and circular economy every day.
Excellent working environment and Flexible hours.
We offer the B2B type of contract for this role.

Join a strategic cloud transformation program focused on modernizing enterprise infrastructure through the adoption of hybrid and multi-cloud solutions
. You will play a key role in designing and governing scalable, secure, and cost-efficient cloud platforms while supporting the migration of business-critical workloads from on-premises environments. Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform, Bicep, AWS CDK, or similar tools.
Knowledge of high availability, disaster recovery, backup, and platform resilience concepts.
Familiarity with cloud cost management and FinOps practices.
Experience working in regulated industries, preferably banking or financial services.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and leadership skills.

Experience in designing advanced cloud based AI platforms (GPT/Claude/Gemini) to support complex business tasks.

The assignment is located in a technically mature industrial environment where software is a central part of the customer's products, platforms and solutions. Develop and compile requirements for software architectures.

Contribute to roadmaps for software platforms and architectures.
Drive design issues and component selection.
Building proof of concepts to validate technical solutions.
Support and train software developers in architectural choices and practical application.
Participate in testing, verification, release planning and further development of existing solutions.
Conduct advanced troubleshooting and analysis.
Be the technical contact person for suppliers if necessary.

Master of Science in Engineering or other relevant technical university education.
Very good knowledge of relevant programming languages.
Experience with C#/.NET.

Good knowledge of English.

new_jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced Solution Architect
to join a consulting team supporting a Swedish municipality in strengthening its capabilities across data, analytics, cloud platforms and digital development.
The assignment covers the setup, development and ongoing management of Microsoft Fabric, Azure - including Landing Zones - Power BI, Microsoft 365 and AI solutions, including Power Platform. Microsoft Fabric brings together data movement, data engineering, data science, real-time analytics and BI, while Azure Landing Zones provide a governed and secure foundation for scaling Azure workloads.
You will work closely with business and IT stakeholders, helping translate organisational needs into practical, secure and scalable technical solutions. The engagement covers the full journey: needs analysis, requirements workshops, target architecture and roadmap development, implementation, documentation, governance and knowledge transfer. The project will start in October. You will work in Tyresö.
Key responsibilities

Design target architectures and solution designs for Microsoft-based business, data and digital workplace solutions.
Lead needs analysis and requirements discussions with business users, IT teams and key stakeholders.
Translate business needs into clear technical requirements, solution options and implementation roadmaps.
Support the implementation and development of solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, Azure and Microsoft Fabric.
Establish and improve governance models, operating models and ways of working for Power Platform and related Microsoft services.
Define architecture principles covering security, compliance, integrations, environments, lifecycle management and scalability.
Work with data engineering, BI, data modelling, integrations, AI, information security, data governance and cost management.
Contribute to Azure Landing Zone design and management, including the guardrails needed for secure and scalable workloads.
Support digital workplace initiatives, change management and the adoption of new tools and ways of working.
Produce clear architecture documentation, technical decision records and guidance for development and operational teams.
Work as part of a multidisciplinary consulting team that includes specialists in Azure, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, AI, product ownership, testing and quality assurance.
Support knowledge transfer to the municipality’s internal business and IT teams.

Ideal candidate profile

At least 5 years of experience as a Solution Architect or in an equivalent architecture role focused on Microsoft-based business solutions.
Hands-on experience designing and implementing solutions using Microsoft Power Platform and/or Dynamics 365.
Proven experience leading needs analyses, requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions.
Ability to translate business requirements into clear, practical and scalable technical solutions.
Experience establishing governance models, governance frameworks or operating models for Power Platform or comparable enterprise platforms.
Experience advising organisations on target architectures, digitalisation initiatives or modern business-platform strategy.
Good understanding of Microsoft Azure, cloud architecture and enterprise integration patterns.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, data platforms, analytics or related data-management concepts is highly desirable.
Understanding of governance, information security, compliance and cost management in cloud-based environments.
Strong communication, facilitation and documentation skills.
Ability to work effectively with both business and IT stakeholders.
Professional proficiency in Swedish and English
, both written and spoken. Swedish is mandatory because the end client is a Swedish municipality and the role involves close collaboration, requirements work and documentation in a public-sector setting.
Rediness to join the project from October, 19th

Conditions

Location: Tyresö Kommun.
Work model: On-site initially; hybrid work may be possible later.
Workload: Full-time, 100%.
Assignment period: 1 year, with a possibility of extension until October 2030.
Start: October, 19th

Vi erbjuder en trygg och professionell miljö där samarbete, kvalitet och hållbara arbetssätt står i centrum.

Är du den vi söker?

Du trivs i uppdrag där du får:

designa och implementera robusta integrationslösningar
arbeta med modern eventdriven arkitektur
skapa tydliga API-strukturer och flöden som håller över tid
analysera verksamhetsprocesser och omsätta dem i tekniska lösningar
etablera principer, mallar och referensarkitektur
guida team i CI/CD, IaC och goda integrationsmönster

Integrationsarkitektur

API-design (REST, eventdrivet, hybridlösningar)
patterns för köer, pub/sub, integrationsplattformar och pipelines

Data & Flöden

analys av systemlandskap och informationsmodeller
monitoreringsstrategier och operational readiness

Dev & CI/CD

infrastructure as code och automatiserad deployment
teststrategier för integration och flöden

Verksamhetsnära arkitektur

workshops och behovsinsamling
stöd inför upphandlingar och tekniska vägval
affärsförståelse inom energi, bank/finans, industri, offentlig sektor m.m.

Vilka vi tror att du är

Vi tror att du:

gillar att skapa tydlighet i komplexa systemlandskap
har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera tekniska beslut
är trygg i rollen och trivs nära både utveckling och verksamhet
är prestigelös, inkluderande och värdesätter teamets framgång
är nyfiken på nya tekniker och arbetssätt, t.ex. AI‑drivna verktyg
vill arbeta långsiktigt och hållbart, tillsammans med andra

affärskritiska – där data och flöden är centrala för verksamheten
långsiktiga – med tid att göra det rätt, inte bara snabbt
moderna – med Azure, moln, automatisering och nya arbetssätt
stabila – med erfarna team och kunder som litar på oss

Vi matchar dig utifrån din kompetens och dina ambitioner — inte mot första lediga uppdrag.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer
who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

If you're excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Your Mission

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Systems

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Design API-First Architecture

Create robust APIs that connect internal services, booking channels, third-party providers, and customer systems.

Integrate the Ecosystem

Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other strategic partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Scale Infrastructure

Deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure designed for reliability, performance, and global growth across multiple property management businesses.

Solve Complex Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
Dynamic pricing intelligence
Smart lock access and key management
Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Move Fast and Own Delivery

Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Bring senior engineering judgment to technical decisions, code reviews, and the reliability of the systems you build.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

Python
FastAPI
React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe
Docker
GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

Strong experience building and owning production-grade software systems
Experience with FastAPI, Python, React, or similar frameworks
Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
Experience designing scalable backend systems and reliable data models
The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions
Strong problem-solving skills and a product mindset
Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
A bias toward action, shipping, and learning from real users
The ability to balance delivery speed with maintainability and reliability

Bonus Points For Experience With

Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

Core short-term rental workflows are automated through systems you've built
Property managers spend less time on manual administration
Reservations, availability, payments, and operational data move reliably between systems
New integrations are deployed and maintained reliably
AI-powered workflows become part of customers’ everyday operations
The platform supports more operators and properties while maintaining reliability and performance
Base360.ai helps customers grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Extreme Ownership

Have the freedom and responsibility to make technical decisions and deliver systems that matter.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
You prefer a narrowly defined role with limited product involvement
You need detailed instructions for every task
You avoid ownership and accountability
You're comfortable shipping work without taking responsibility for its quality

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

Ohjelmistokehittäjä osallistuu Microsoft Power Platform-, Azure- ja tekoälyratkaisujen suunnitteluun, toteutukseen, testaamiseen ja ylläpitoon. Roolissa yhdistyvät low-code-kehitys, perinteinen ohjelmistokehitys sekä nykyaikaisten pilvipalveluiden hyödyntäminen osana liiketoimintaratkaisuja.

: Full-Time (2-Year Limited Term with a strong possibility of extension or transition to an indefinite contract)

Detailed Description

Full professional level; applies software engineering expertise in a specific area of specialization. Works on problems of moderate to diverse scope where analysis of technical requirements, system architectures and data schemas requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Exercises technical judgment within defined procedures and software development practices to determine appropriate action. Receives general instructions on routine development tasks and detailed instructions on new projects or complex system assignments. Builds productive collaborative relationships across development, QA and business analyst teams.

Performs tasks such as, but not limited to, the following:

Contribute actively to the software design and end-to-end delivery of scalable enterprise web applications using ASP.NET Core MVC and .NET 10, collaborating with senior engineers and the dedicated architect to implement robust technical solutions.
Support the modernization and rewrite process, migrating legacy Java and Java ADF application functionalities into a high-performance .NET architecture while ensuring functional parity.
Balance legacy modernization with new features enablement, designing and building brand-new product capabilities from scratch to deliver strategic business value.
Collaborate with senior engineers and the dedicated architect to implement robust architectural foundations, design RESTful APIs and optimize data flows integrated with Oracle DB.
Deliver clean, maintainable and scalable code by strictly adhering to SOLID principles and Clean Code practices.
Manage modern development workflows in GitLab, utilizing standardized branching strategies, merge request processes and CI/CD practices.
Work closely within a collaborative team environment, actively sharing knowledge on modern .NET development, participating in peer code reviews and contributing to a culture of continuous learning.
Ensure application reliability and stability by defining and implementing code testing standards, structured debugging and proactive performance optimization.
Proactively identify and resolve technical debt, modernize user interfaces and enhance application stability, security and performance.
Collaborate with IT/Business partners, leadership and global stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical specifications.
Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectural designs, system configurations and database schemas to ensure long-term maintainability.

Knowledge/Skills/Competencies

Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in the .NET ecosystem, with a strong passion for modern C# features and ASP.NET Core.
Solid expertise in software design and architecture (Dependency Injection, Repository Pattern, Clean Architecture and Modular Design), with the ability to propose and implement scalable solutions.
Advanced proficiency in Database Architecture and SQL, with experience optimizing Entity Framework Core integrated with Oracle DB (experience with other relational databases such as PostgreSQL or SQL Server is highly acceptable).
Competency in web development and frontend integration, combining ASP.NET Core MVC with JavaScript to build highly interactive, responsive and performant user interfaces using UI components (such as Telerik UI), along with basic HTML and CSS skills.
Hands-on experience with version control and modern Git workflows (GitLab, branch protection, Merge Requests) along with exposure to CI/CD automation pipelines.
Proven ability to work collaboratively within a development team, take technical ownership of features, manage priorities and drive quality standards through constructive code reviews.
Exceptional verbal and written English skills for cross-cultural collaboration, negotiating technical requirements and explaining complex .NET concepts to team members.
Flexibility to occasionally participate in technical discussions and align on architecture with managers and architects in the Canada timezone (EST).
Self-driven, proactive mindset with a focus on writing highly scalable, long-term maintainable code and a desire to contribute to architectural discussions.
Basic familiarity or openness to reading Java and Java ADF code to understand existing legacy business logic is considered an asset (previous hands-on Java development is not required).
Understanding of Supply Chain Management (SCM) processes or ERP workflows is considered an asset (openness and willingness to learn these business processes is highly valued).

Openness to utilizing modern development tools and AI-assisted engineering practices is preferred.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
About Us

Base360.ai
is the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses, helping property managers run their operations on autopilot.

Born out of The Flex, a short-term rental operator that scaled to an eight-figure business using its own software, Base360.ai is now launching as a standalone platform for short-term rental operators worldwide.

We bring reservations, guest communication, pricing, payments, cleaning, maintenance, and reporting into one platform—helping operators automate manual work, reduce costs, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios.

We're looking for a highly ambitious Senior Software Engineer
who wants to build systems that solve real problems at scale. You'll build, ship, automate, and deliver products that directly impact property managers, their teams, and their guests.

If you're excited by APIs, automation, AI agents, cloud infrastructure, and building products from the ground up, we want to meet you.

What You'll Build

As a Senior Software Engineer, you'll help architect and scale Base360.ai—the platform powering every aspect of a short-term rental business.

You'll build customer-facing products, automation engines, AI-powered workflows, integrations, and operational systems that help property managers grow without increasing their workload at the same rate.

Your work will span the entire short-term rental lifecycle: from listing distribution, pricing, and bookings to guest stays, property operations, and financial reporting.

Your Mission

Build the Core Platform

Design and develop scalable applications, services, and APIs that power reservations, availability, pricing, payments, guest experiences, and property operations.

Create Powerful Automations

Build event-driven workflows that eliminate repetitive work—from scheduling cleaning after a booking to sending check-in instructions and generating owner statements.

Develop AI-Powered Systems

Use LLMs and AI agents to automate guest communication, triage maintenance requests, support pricing decisions, and help operators manage their portfolios more efficiently.

Design API-First Architecture

Create robust APIs that connect internal services, booking channels, third-party providers, and customer systems.

Integrate the Ecosystem

Build and maintain integrations with platforms including Airbnb, Hostaway, Stripe, Twilio, OpenAI, Google, and other strategic partners across the short-term rental ecosystem.

Scale Infrastructure

Deploy and manage cloud-native infrastructure designed for reliability, performance, and global growth across multiple property management businesses.

Solve Complex Operational Problems

Build Solutions For

Real-time reservation and availability synchronization
Dynamic pricing intelligence
Smart lock access and key management
Automated guest communication across channels
Operational forecasting
Cleaning and maintenance automation
Owner reporting and financial workflows
AI-powered monitoring and alerts

Move Fast and Own Delivery

Own projects end-to-end—from understanding an operator’s problem to architecture, implementation, deployment, and ongoing improvement.

Bring senior engineering judgment to technical decisions, code reviews, and the reliability of the systems you build.

Tech Stack

We care more about capability than specific technologies, but our current stack includes:

Python
FastAPI
React
TypeScript
Supabase
PostgreSQL
AWS
Serverless architecture
OpenAI APIs
Twilio
Stripe
Docker
GitHub Actions

You Might Be a Great Fit If You Have

Strong experience building and owning production-grade software systems
Experience with FastAPI, Python, React, or similar frameworks
Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, and cloud architecture
Experience designing scalable backend systems and reliable data models
The ability to work independently and make sound technical decisions
Strong problem-solving skills and a product mindset
Curiosity about AI, automation, and operational efficiency
A bias toward action, shipping, and learning from real users
The ability to balance delivery speed with maintainability and reliability

Bonus Points For Experience With

Short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or property management systems
Multi-tenant SaaS platforms
Marketplace businesses and booking channel integrations
AI agents and workflow automation
Event-driven architectures
Supabase
AWS serverless infrastructure

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12 Months

Core short-term rental workflows are automated through systems you've built
Property managers spend less time on manual administration
Reservations, availability, payments, and operational data move reliably between systems
New integrations are deployed and maintained reliably
AI-powered workflows become part of customers’ everyday operations
The platform supports more operators and properties while maintaining reliability and performance
Base360.ai helps customers grow their portfolios, improve guest experiences, and operate more profitably

Why Join Us

Build Something Meaningful

Solve problems experienced daily by short-term rental operators, with direct access to The Flex’s operations to test ideas and see their impact.

Extreme Ownership

Have the freedom and responsibility to make technical decisions and deliver systems that matter.

Small Team, Massive Opportunity

Work closely with the founders and directly influence the product and technical direction of Base360.ai.

Learn Faster

Solve real-world challenges across software, AI, automation, hospitality operations, and scale.

Performance-Based Rewards

Competitive compensation with substantial upside for exceptional performers.

Remote-First

Work from anywhere. We care about outcomes, not hours.

This Role Is Not For You If

You're looking for a slow-paced corporate environment
You prefer a narrowly defined role with limited product involvement
You need detailed instructions for every task
You avoid ownership and accountability
You're comfortable shipping work without taking responsibility for its quality

We're looking for someone who wants to help build the AI operating system for the short-term rental industry.

This job advertisement is published on behalf of our partner Goldright.

Data is the fuel for AI and digital transformation – but only if it can be trusted.

This is where Goldright comes in: With our Enterprise Suite, we provide the essential ‘Trust Layer’ for global players and mid-sized companies. We deliver the reliable foundation that enables our customers to realize AI projects and make strategic decisions with confidence. But we don’t just enable AI for others; we breathe it ourselves.

YOUR JOB

As a Software Engineer
, you will be responsible for the continuous development and enhancement of our core product
. In this role, you will work across a broad technical spectrum, bringing in your own ideas to shape the product’s future, utilizing modern development practices—including integrating and developing AI features
directly within our solutions.

You will join a close-knit, Graz-based team of developers, collaborating tightly with Consultants, Operations and the IT department to deliver high-quality software.

Your Job’s Key Responsibilities Are

Developing high-quality software solutions and web application fundamentals using Java Core, Spring, and relational databases, with a willingness to dive into front-end topics when needed
Collaborating within a versatile team where everyone is encouraged to be a generalist, while still having room to focus on their preferred areas of expertise
Working closely with Consultants to ensure our API provides clean, flexible customization boundaries, enabling them to easily adapt the product to specific customer needs
Actively participating in our developer-driven agile workflow: enjoying 3-week sprints, dailies 3 times a week, and the freedom to self-select the tasks you want to work on
Taking part in collaborative sprint planning as well as joint sprint reviews with the entire team
Ensuring product quality through smart testing practices and conducting peer code reviews for major technical implementations
Driving innovation with AI: utilizing AI tools to accelerate your daily development and directly building advanced AI features for our product

Your Skills

Essential Skills:

3+ years of work experience in software development with Java
Completed technical studies related to software engineering or equivalent practical experience/training in software development
Solid knowledge of software development principles, database modeling (SQL), and relational databases.
Strong understanding of server-side web application fundamentals and an openness to working on both back-end and front-end topics
High personal standards regarding product quality, performance, and security
Good communication skills in English (minimum B2 level) to collaborate effectively with local and cross-functional teams
A proactive, collaborative mindset to bring your own ideas to the table, position oneself where the biggest impact can be made, and find creative solutions in a broad product landscape

Beneficial Skills

Knowledge of modern container and cluster technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
Experience with cloud technologies such as Azure or Google Cloud Platform
Solid experience with the Spring framework
Familiarity with JavaScript/TypeScript or other programming languages
Experience with Hibernate/JPA
Understanding of CI/CD processes and tools
German language skills

new_jobs.description:
Your new home base at Körber is the Körber Supply Chain Consulting team.

A smoothly running supply chain of goods, end-to-end, is what makes today’s world go round. Here is your chance to become part of this challenge. At Körber Supply Chain Consulting, we work with our customers to envisage and implement their supply chains for tomorrow. We work with best-in-class software companies such as SAP and turn our customers’ end-to-end supply chain vision into reality. We bring supply-chain intelligence and advanced digital expertise gained through many projects. We ensure seamless integration into our customers’ overall IT landscapes, even down to driving automation technology at the hardware level.

If you enjoy software engineering and consulting applied to real-life challenges in warehousing, transport management, yard management and manufacturing execution, you do not need to look any further.

Your role in our team

Together with your team colleagues, you will support and maintain software solutions for innovative logistics systems for our national and international customers.
You will analyse incidents, troubleshoot issues and implement sustainable solutions to ensure stable system operations.
As a full-stack developer, you will maintain, enhance and optimise existing applications in .NET, C#, Java, JavaScript and 3-tier web architectures.
You will work closely with customers to resolve operational challenges and ensure the reliability and performance of productive systems.
You will implement change requests and enhancements within existing customer environments while ensuring minimal disruption to operations.
You will work with Oracle and Microsoft SQL Server databases to support and improve application performance.
Your primary focus will be on application support, maintenance, incident management and continuous improvement of existing customer solutions rather than project-driven software implementations or greenfield development.
You are willing to participate in a 24x7 support rotation to ensure that business-critical customer systems remain operational.

Your profile

You have a degree in business informatics, computer science or a comparable programme, or you have completed vocational training in IT.
You have gained initial professional experience in software development, application support, software maintenance or IT operations.
Candidates with junior to mid-level experience who are eager to develop within a support-oriented role are encouraged to apply.
Experience with .NET, C#, Java, JavaScript, databases or comparable technologies is beneficial.
Knowledge of JIRA, Azure DevOps, Git, SVN or similar tools is an advantage.
You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills as well as a structured approach to troubleshooting.
You possess strong communication skills, a customer-oriented mindset and enjoy working in an international environment.
You are fluent in English and are willing to participate in a 24x7 on-call and support model.

Your Benefits

Exciting challenges in national and international SAP implementation projects in different industries
Taking on responsibility and the opportunity to make a difference from day one. Compatibility of work, family and free time through flexible working hours, mobile working - also from home
Working in an environment with a good team spirit, solidarity, and mutual support
Personal development opportunities in a growing team
Flat hierarchies and short communication channels
Ongoing training and further education
Personal mentoring and individual development opportunities

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. You can find out more about our culture here Culture at Körber - it's worth taking a look!

We are committed to providing an accessible working environment. Applications from people with a recognized disability under German law, including people with severe disabilities or equivalent status, are expressly welcome. We would appreciate it if you could voluntarily indicate this directly in your CV or cover letter so that we can support you as effectively as possible throughout the process. You can find out more about the work of our representative body for people with severe disabilities here. They are happy to answer any confidential questions you may have in advance.

If you have any questions or technical problems, please send us an e-mail to jobs@koerber.com.

DXC helps global companies run their mission-critical systems and operations while modernizing IT, optimizing data architectures and ensuring security and scalability across public, private and hybrid clouds.
